items.title: Proyecto cable submarino en Mediterráneo oriental pide reanudar investigación de lecho marino, según Grecia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Grecia dijo el jueves que la empresa promotora de un proyecto de cable eléctrico submarino respaldado por la UE en el Mediterráneo oriental solicitó una licencia para reanudar estudios del lecho marino, algo fundamental para que el proyecto, que lleva tiempo retrasado, pueda seguir adelante.
items.body:
Grecia dijo el jueves que la empresa promotora de un proyecto de cable eléctrico submarino respaldado por la UE en el Mediterráneo oriental solicitó una licencia para reanudar estudios del lecho marino, algo fundamental para que el proyecto, que lleva tiempo retrasado, pueda seguir adelante.
La construcción del Great Sea Interconnector (GSI) tiene como objetivo conectar el continente europeo con Chipre y, posteriormente, con Israel, pero cuenta con la oposición de Turquía.
El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, declaró la semana pasada en Atenas que Estados Unidos estaba "muy comprometido" con el proyecto, ya que promueve la diversificación del suministro energético, necesaria debido a la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania y a la situación en el estrecho de Ormuz.
El operador de la red eléctrica griega, IPTO (ADMr.AT) , está desarrollando este proyecto de 1.900 millones de euros (2.130 millones de dólares). La empresa francesa Nexans (NEXS.PA) , contratista encargada del cableado, ha solicitado en nombre del GSI un permiso griego para realizar estudios del lecho marino, informó el jueves a periodistas el portavoz del Gobierno griego, Pavlos Marinakis.
El avance del proyecto ha sido lento debido a una disputa entre Grecia y Turquía sobre la zona marítima que se destinará al tendido del cable.
Grecia espera reanudar pronto los estudios del lecho marino para determinar el trazado, una medida que, según Turquía, requeriría una coordinación previa entre ambos países, ya que atraviesa una zona incluida en un acuerdo marítimo de 2019 con Libia, que Atenas ha rechazado.
Marinakis afirmó que los estudios los llevará a cabo un buque francés y que comenzarán una vez que un comité ministerial griego encargado de autorizar la investigación marina en las zonas marítimas griegas y la guardia costera griega aprueben la solicitud.
"En lo que respecta a la ejecución del proyecto, Grecia no ha llegado a ningún acuerdo con las autoridades de ningún otro Estado que no sean Francia y Chipre —lo cual es lógico—", afirmó Marinakis.
Rubio declaró la semana pasada que Estados Unidos recurrirá a la diplomacia para intentar eliminar cualquier posible obstáculo.

items.title: Gulf cost edge keeps chemical buyers hooked despite Hormuz risks
items.author: Pooja Menon
items.creator: Pooja Menon
items.summary: Chemical buyers are unlikely to permanently shift away from Middle Eastern suppliers despite disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, as the region's competitive pricing and production scale remain difficult to rival, analysts said.
items.body:
Chemical buyers are unlikely to permanently shift away from Middle Eastern suppliers despite disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, as the region's competitive pricing and production scale remain difficult to rival, analysts said.
The Middle East accounted for more than 40% of global polyethylene exports last year, supplying Asia, Europe and Latin America with petrochemicals used in packaging, consumer goods and industrial products.
The Strait's closure following the US-Israeli war on Iran in late February has taken nearly 20% of global ethylene capacity and as much as 40% of Asian naphtha supply offline, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence, [USN:L4N40C10N TEXT:"pushing prices"] higher.
Brett Massimino, an associate professor of supply chain and analytics at Virginia Commonwealth University, said the disruptions have accelerated "dual sourcing".
Gulf producers retain most volumes because of their cost advantage, while domestic and regional suppliers have captured roughly 20% of demand, up from almost negligible levels before the war.
COST ADVANTAGE LIMITS BUYER EXODUS Chemical buyers remain reliant on the Middle East because of its proximity to Asian and European markets and abundant naphtha supplies, said Maksim Sonin, an energy executive affiliated with Stanford University's Center for Fuels of the Future and Hydrogen Initiative.
A BASF (BASFn.DE) spokesperson told Reuters that recent disruptions have reinforced the importance of diversifying supply chains, but are unlikely to diminish the Middle East's long-term significance, given its cost advantages and extensive production base.
It remains uncertain whether sourcing patterns will fully return to pre-crisis levels, the spokesperson added.
Price remains the dominant factor in purchasing decisions, particularly for commodity chemicals, said Morningstar analyst Christian Flemming.
NEAR-TERM SHIFT POSSIBLE Concerns about reliable Middle Eastern supply could boost near-term demand for North American petrochemicals.
"However, these shifts are typically temporary, and we do not expect a permanent move away from Middle Eastern suppliers," Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said.
Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar remain among the world's most competitive petrochemical producers, benefiting from cheap hydrocarbon feedstocks and decades of investment that few regions can match.
"Chemical companies are still viewing the conflict in the Middle East as temporary rather than a trend, but we may still see shifts in trade flows due to other factors," said Elizabeth Sterner, assistant professor of chemistry at Lebanon Valley College in Pennsylvania.
She added supply disruptions and reduced polyethylene availability in parts of the Middle East have pushed prices higher, prompting some North American and European producers to raise ethylene cracking rates to capture demand.
PRODUCERS BENEFIT FROM TIGHTER MARKETS The supply disruptions have tightened global chemical markets, giving producers greater pricing power and allowing them to pass higher costs on to customers.
Dow (DOW.N) Chief Financial Officer Jeff Tate said in July that polyethylene prices had risen more than 40% since late February, while Eastman Chemical (EMN.N) reported a nearly 10% increase in its second-quarter revenue, supported by higher volumes and a 4% rise in selling prices.
A Wacker Chemie (WCHG.DE) spokesperson said the company had secured raw materials, continued to meet demand and passed on some conflict-related costs to customers.
items.raw_description: Chemical buyers are unlikely to permanently shift away from Middle Eastern suppliers despite disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, as the region's competitive pricing and production scale remain difficult to rival, analysts said.

items.title: Dólar cae desde pico de 18 meses por bajada de retorno de bonos y de expectativas sobre tasas
items.author: Sophie Kiderlin
items.creator: Sophie Kiderlin
items.summary: El dólar caía el jueves desde un máximo de 18 meses, lastrado por el fuerte descenso del rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense, mientras las declaraciones cautas de las autoridades monetarias de la Reserva Federal atenuaban las expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés en octubre, pese a los fuertes datos de inflación.
items.body:
El dólar caía el jueves desde un máximo de 18 meses, lastrado por el fuerte descenso del rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense, mientras las declaraciones cautas de las autoridades monetarias de la Reserva Federal atenuaban las expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés en octubre, pese a los fuertes datos de inflación.
* El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas divisas, restaba un 0,2%, a 102,03 unidades, tras haber alcanzado el miércoles un máximo en 18 meses después de que las cifras de inflación en Estados Unidos resultaran más altas de lo esperado.
* El euro repuntaba un 0,5% desde un mínimo de 18 meses, a 1,1216 dólares, en camino de su mayor avance diario en casi dos meses. La libra esterlina ganaba un 0,5%, a 1,3253 dólares, tras datos que mostraron que la economía británica creció de forma inesperada un 0,1% en agosto.
* Los mercados se mostraban volátiles, ya que los elevados datos del IPC estadounidense del miércoles reforzaron inicialmente las apuestas por unas tasas más altas durante más tiempo. Asimismo, se reavivó la preocupación sobre la elevada carga de deuda de las empresas de inteligencia artificial, impulsando los flujos hacia valores de refugio como los bonos del Tesoro.
* Además de los movimientos en el rendimiento de los bonos y el nerviosismo en los mercados bursátiles —con las acciones tecnológicas especialmente afectadas—, Kit Juckes, estratega jefe de divisas de Société Générale, también señaló que los cambios en el posicionamiento influían en la evolución del dólar.
* "Hay un pequeño tira y afloja entre quienes esperan una corrección del dólar. Como el posicionamiento es demasiado grande, hemos avanzado mucho, no hay muchas noticias nuevas, tenemos muchas alzas de tasas descontadas, etcétera. Y luego están los datos económicos, que pueden dar un vuelco a la situación", afirmó.
* "Sospecho que el mercado estará volátil y agitado hasta que hayamos superado las cifras de ventas minoristas y del índice de precios al productor (IPP)", agregó, en referencia a dos datos que se conocerán más tarde en la sesión.
* El yen se fortalecía en la jornada, cotizando a 157,8 unidades por dólar.

items.title: Índia diz que 1ª fase do acordo comercial com EUA está quase concluída e insiste em vantagem sobre concorrentes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A primeira fase de um acordo comercial entre Índia e EUA está em fase final de elaboração, afirmou na quinta-feira o ministro do Comércio da Índia, mas reiterou que Nova Délhi só seguirá adiante se garantir vantagem sobre os exportadores concorrentes.
items.body:
A primeira fase de um acordo comercial entre Índia e EUA está em fase final de elaboração, afirmou na quinta-feira o ministro do Comércio da Índia, mas reiterou que Nova Délhi só seguirá adiante se garantir vantagem sobre os exportadores concorrentes.
Nova Délhi e Washington chegaram a um acordo sobre uma estrutura para o pacto em fevereiro, o que reduziu de 50% para 18% a tarifa punitiva sobre a maioria dos produtos indianos, imposta em agosto do ano passado após o fracasso de uma rodada anterior de negociações.
Desde então, as negociações têm enfrentado obstáculos, com autoridades de ambos os lados sinalizando que os esforços para chegar a um acordo final se tornaram mais lentos.
O ministro do Comércio da Índia, Piyush Goyal, disse que a “primeira parcela” do acordo seria finalizada em breve.
“Estamos passando pelos últimos detalhes, pela redação jurídica, e esperamos poder finalizar isso em breve e colocá-lo em prática assim que obtivermos uma vantagem comparável ou competitiva em relação aos países semelhantes”, afirmou ele, segundo um comunicado de seu gabinete, durante um evento em Nova Délhi.
Goyal se referia aos esforços de Nova Délhi para garantir uma vantagem tarifária aos exportadores indianos em relação a economias concorrentes, como Bangladesh, Vietnã e Indonésia, no mercado dos EUA.
A Índia quer garantir que seus exportadores não enfrentem tarifas mais altas do que as impostas às economias concorrentes.
As negociações comerciais têm ocorrido em um contexto de relações cada vez mais tensas entre Índia e Estados Unidos, o que complica os esforços para estabilizar sua parceria comercial.
O secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, visitará a Índia e o Uzbequistão, de 17 a 22 de outubro, e se reunirá com líderes governamentais e empresariais para discutir cooperação energética, investimentos comerciais e laços econômicos mais amplos.

items.title: UK's Healey should rebuild fiscal headroom to about £15-16 billion, Reuters poll shows
items.author: Andy Bruce
items.creator: Andy Bruce
items.summary: British finance minister John Healey should rebuild his depleted headroom against the fiscal rules to about £15-16 billion ($20-21 billion) at this month's budget to keep bond investors onside, a Reuters poll of economists showed on Thursday.
items.body:
British finance minister [USN:S8N4040BJ TEXT:"John Healey"] should rebuild his depleted headroom against the fiscal rules to about £15-16 billion ($20-21 billion) at this month's budget to keep bond investors onside, a Reuters poll of economists showed on Thursday.
Headroom, the buffer by which the government's current tax and spending plans meet its fiscal rules, has halved since the March fiscal update to around £10-12 billion from £23.6 billion, the poll's median forecast showed.
But some of the 19 economists surveyed, from large banks and consultancies, put headroom as low as £5 billion, reflecting uncertainty over how the Office for Budget Responsibility will score the many factors that feed into its calculations.
The government's stability rule requires it to balance the current budget, meaning day-to-day spending against revenue, by 2029/30 — something it has achieved only fleetingly in the past 25 years.
Healey, who has again pledged to meet the fiscal rules in full, presents his budget on October 28. He said on Thursday he wanted it to give households some "breathing space", and economists expect further modest cost-of-living measures, offset by increases to some of the smaller taxes.
"The government enters the Autumn Budget with a significantly weaker fiscal position than in March," UBS Investment Bank economist Anna Titareva said.
"We expect the Chancellor to target fiscal buffer of (around) £15 billion rather than restore the March level, but even this would imply difficult trade-offs," Titareva added.
Such a level of headroom would be thin by historic standards, equivalent to just 0.5% of economic output.
The [USN:L8N45V18B TEXT:"Institute for Fiscal Studies"] said on Monday that headroom could fall only modestly, to around £20 billion from £24 billion in March, if the OBR judges that higher inflation will lift earnings growth and income tax revenues enough to offset most of the extra debt interest and welfare costs.
Britain's 10-year government bond yields are the highest in the Group of Seven, a gap analysts attribute mainly to interest rate and inflation expectations rather than renewed investor nerves over the budget.
A wider poll of the same economists on Thursday showed the [USN:L6N4600XN TEXT:"Bank of England"] is likely to raise interest rates in November, although they were divided about the prospect of further rate hikes.
In local-currency total return terms, gilts have beaten most G7 peers over the past month and sit mid-table for the year to date, according to FTSE indexes.
Even so, Healey will need to tread carefully. The bond market turmoil that followed former Prime Minister Liz Truss's September 2022 "mini-budget" remains a cautionary tale.
"Markets probably can tolerate modestly lower headroom in the short term, but we think the fiscal plan will lack credibility," Rob Wood, chief UK economist at consultancy Pantheon Macroeconomics, said.
"Tiny headroom also leaves the forecast highly sensitive to rates: another 30 basis-point rise in gilt yields and Bank Rate would cut it by about £5 billion. That leaves asymmetric upside risk to gilt yields."
($1 = 0.7543 pounds)

items.title: Minério de ferro atinge menor cotação em 2 anos com preocupações sobre demanda fraca e aumento da oferta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os preços do minério de ferro caíram pela terceira sessão consecutiva nesta quinta-feira, atingindo o nível mais baixo em mais de dois anos, pressionados por preocupações persistentes com a demanda fraca na China e pelas perspectivas de aumento da oferta do insumo para a produção de aço.
items.body:
Os preços do minério de ferro caíram pela terceira sessão consecutiva nesta quinta-feira, atingindo o nível mais baixo em mais de dois anos, pressionados por preocupações persistentes com a demanda fraca na China e pelas perspectivas de aumento da oferta do insumo para a produção de aço.
O contrato de minério de ferro mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) na China recuperou parte das perdas registradas mais cedo e encerrou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,44%, a 671,5 iuanes (US$100,36) por tonelada. No início do pregão, o contrato atingiu o nível mais baixo desde 24 de setembro de 2024, a 667 iuanes.
A referência de minério de ferro para novembro na Bolsa de Cingapura recuava 0,66%, cotada a US$89,85 por tonelada, no menor patamar desde 24 de setembro de 2024.
A demanda por aço no setor de transformação enfraqueceu na alta temporada, enquanto a oferta de minério de ferro do projeto Simandou, na Guiné, deve aumentar, afirmaram analistas da corretora Zhengxin Futures em nota.
Esse cenário, aliado à queda nas taxas de frete, sugere um potencial espaço para novas quedas nos preços futuros do minério, acrescentaram.
[USN:L4N46008B TEXT:"As importações de minério de ferro"] da China nos primeiros nove meses de 2026 aumentaram 4,1% em relação ao ano anterior, totalizando 954,97 milhões de toneladas, mantendo as importações anuais deste ano a caminho de um recorde histórico.
Uma onda de compras na baixa ajudou a reduzir as perdas nos preços à tarde, afirmaram os analistas.
(Reportagem de Amy Lv e Lewis Jackson)

Oct 15 : Anthropic should delay its US IPO until it addresses concerns about safety, governance and the pace of development, urged New York City Comptroller Mark Levine in a letter to the AI lab's CEO Dario Amodei, CNBC reported on Thursday.
AI systems have advanced rapidly over the past 12 months, outpacing regulation and drawing scrutiny over potential risks including safety, cybersecurity threats and misuse.
"Instead of proceeding headlong with its IPO, the company should focus its energies on addressing these unprecedented risks," Levine wrote, according to CNBC.
The office of the NYC Comptroller and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.

Oct 15 : Anthropic should delay its US IPO until it addresses concerns about safety, governance and the pace of development, urged New York City Comptroller Mark Levine in a letter to the AI lab's CEO Dario Amodei, CNBC reported on Thursday.
AI systems have advanced rapidly over the past 12 months, outpacing regulation and drawing scrutiny over potential risks including safety, cybersecurity threats and misuse.
"Instead of proceeding headlong with its IPO, the company should focus its energies on addressing these unprecedented risks," Levine wrote, according to CNBC.
The office of the NYC Comptroller and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.

items.title: UK government says it is minded to intervene in Sky-ITV deal
items.author: Paul Sandle
items.creator: Paul Sandle
items.summary: British culture minister Lisa Nandy said on Thursday she was minded to intervene in Comcast's Sky deal to buy the broadcast channels and streaming service of Britain's ITV for £1.6 billion ($2.1 billion).
items.body:
British culture minister Lisa Nandy said on Thursday she was minded to intervene in Comcast's (CMCSA.O) Sky deal [USN:L4N4380AQ TEXT:"to buy"] the broadcast channels and streaming service of Britain's ITV (ITV.L) for £1.6 billion ($2.1 billion).
Nandy said she had potential concerns about the deal's impact on the breadth of news providers in Britain, as well as the extent of Sky's control over the media.
She told the two companies she would also examine whether the deal could reduce the availability of high-quality programmes appealing to a wide variety of tastes and interests.
That concern would extend to on-demand as well as broadcast content, and would require an amendment to the existing grounds for intervention to reflect new viewing habits, she said.
Sky agreed in July to buy ITV's broadcast business, home to programmes such as "Coronation Street", national news provided by ITN and popular regional news shows.
Sky already owns rival news provider Sky News, as well as sports and entertainment channels.
ITV Chief Executive Carolyn McCall said at the time she expected the deal to be subject to a lengthy review.
The two companies have until October 20 to respond to Nandy's concerns.
($1 = 0.7550 pounds)

items.title: CERN and Mistral partner to build AI foundation models for physics
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: European physics research centre CERN and Mistral AI have signed a statement of intent to establish a long-term strategic partnership to develop foundation models for scientific discovery, the two organisations said on Thursday.
items.body:
European physics research centre CERN and Mistral AI have signed a statement of intent to establish a long-term strategic partnership to develop foundation models for scientific discovery, the two organisations said on Thursday.
The partners aim to build a "Large Physics Model", which CERN said in a statement would be the first foundation model for collider physics, trained on billions of simulated particle collisions.
It is meant to replace some specialised algorithms now used to reconstruct and identify particles.
CERN holds about one exabyte, or one million terabytes, of experimental data from the Large Hadron Collider, and expects the volume of collisions to increase tenfold after its ongoing upgrade, expected around 2030.
"High-energy physics provides a unique environment in which artificial intelligence can be developed and tested with exceptional rigour," CERN Chief Information Officer Enrica Porcari said.
No timeline or budget was disclosed. Both sides said the models could later serve other sciences.
items.raw_description: European physics research centre CERN and Mistral AI have signed a statement of intent to establish a long-term strategic partnership to develop foundation models for scientific discovery, the two organisations said on Thursday.

items.title: What is the 'hospital of the popes' where Leo is recovering from surgery?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rome's Gemelli Hospital has become the preferred medical facility for modern pontiffs since the time of Pope John Paul II.
items.body:
Rome's Gemelli Hospital, where Pope Leo is [USN:L8N4610IA TEXT:"recovering after surgery"] for [USN:L8N46006S TEXT:"lung cancer"], is known as the "hospital of the popes".
The hospital, with a suite especially for popes, has become the preferred medical facility for modern pontiffs since the time of Pope John Paul II.
WHAT IS THE GEMELLI? Located some 5 km (3 miles) from the Vatican City, the Gemelli hospital offers every major medical speciality under one roof. It also serves as the teaching hospital of the Catholic University of the Sacred Heart and has more than 1,600 beds.
There is a dedicated suite for popes on the 10th floor, including a private chapel. However, this is currently under renovation, meaning Leo is staying in a different set of rooms.
In the 2026 Newsweek-Statista "World's Best Hospitals" rankings, Gemelli was named as Italy's top hospital and ranked 33rd globally among more than 2,500 hospitals assessed across 32 countries.
HOW DID IT BECOME THE POPES' HOSPITAL? Popes were traditionally treated by doctors summoned to their residence. For example, Pope Paul VI underwent prostate surgery in 1967 in a specially equipped operating room set up inside the Vatican's Apostolic Palace.
Everything changed during the pontificate of John Paul II. He was rushed to the Gemelli after a 1981 assassination attempt, undergoing emergency surgery that saved his life.
He returned repeatedly to the hospital over the following decades for treatment, spending more than 150 days there during his pontificate. He dubbed the place "Vatican III", after the official residences at the Vatican itself and Castel Gandolfo.
Benedict XVI was never admitted during his pontificate.
By contrast, Francis, who died in April 2025, was hospitalised several times, including for colon surgery in 2021, respiratory problems and abdominal surgery in 2023, and for bilateral pneumonia in the weeks before his death.
IS GEMELLI OWNED BY THE VATICAN? The Gemelli hospital was built on land originally owned by the Vatican that was donated by Pope Pius XI in 1934 to the body that oversees the Catholic University. Opened in 1964, it is named after Agostino Gemelli, the Franciscan friar, physician and psychologist who founded the university.
However, despite its close association with the papacy, Gemelli is not a Vatican institution. It operates as a private non-profit academic medical centre within Italy's healthcare system, with most patients treated through the country's publicly funded health service.
The Vatican owns the Bambino Gesù hospital in Rome, but that facility specialises in paediatric care.
items.raw_description: Rome's Gemelli Hospital has become the preferred medical facility for modern pontiffs since the time of Pope John Paul II.

items.title: La china ByteDance crea equipo de seguridad de IA, inicia campaña de contratación a nivel mundial
items.author: Eduardo Baptista
items.creator: Eduardo Baptista
items.summary: Seed, la unidad de investigación en IA del gigante tecnológico chino ByteDance, creó un equipo de "Alineación y Preparación" y ha puesto en marcha una campaña global para contratar a 10 investigadores, afirmando que realizará una inversión a largo plazo en la seguridad de la IA para sus modelos, cada vez más capaces.
items.body:
Seed, la unidad de investigación en IA del gigante tecnológico chino ByteDance, creó un equipo de "Alineación y Preparación" y ha puesto en marcha una campaña global para contratar a 10 investigadores, afirmando que realizará una inversión a largo plazo en la seguridad de la IA para sus modelos, cada vez más capaces.
Esta campaña de contratación se produce en un momento en el que crece el escrutinio sobre la seguridad de los agentes de IA tanto en China como en Estados Unidos, especialmente ahora que los desarrolladores les otorgan autonomía para acceder a Internet.
La "alineación de la IA" se refiere a los esfuerzos por garantizar que los sistemas avanzados de IA actúen en consonancia con los objetivos humanos y los requisitos de seguridad, sobre todo al llevar a cabo tareas complejas que constan de varios pasos.
El anuncio de ByteDance constituye una de las pocas veces en que un importante desarrollador chino de IA ha hecho pública una iniciativa específica centrada en la seguridad de los modelos de vanguardia, la alineación y la preparación ante riesgos emergentes.
El periódico The Paper, respaldado por el Estado, informó el martes que Seed fue el primer laboratorio chino de IA de vanguardia en crear un departamento independiente de seguridad y alineación.
Esta medida se produce además en medio de un debate más amplio entre Estados Unidos y China sobre las medidas de control de la IA, los riesgos de seguridad y los canales de comunicación para informar sobre incidentes importantes relacionados con la IA, incluso mientras ambos países compiten por el liderazgo en el sector.
A medida que mejoran las capacidades de los modelos, la seguridad y la alineación ya no son simplemente medidas de protección frente al riesgo, sino capacidades fundamentales que determinarán si los modelos pueden implementarse a gran escala, afirmó Seed en una oferta de empleo publicada el miércoles en su cuenta oficial de WeChat.
Seed afirmó que proporcionaría al nuevo equipo una capacidad informática y unos recursos de investigación comparables a los de que disponen los equipos dedicados a los modelos de vanguardia. Los puestos se ubicarán en Pekín, Shanghái y San José, California.
Su investigación incluirá formación en seguridad en todas las etapas del desarrollo de modelos, pruebas automatizadas de vulnerabilidades, herramientas para supervisar y explicar el comportamiento de los modelos, entornos de prueba de agentes de IA y preparativos para riesgos emergentes.
Seed afirmó que también buscaría realizar pruebas independientes y colaboraría con universidades e instituciones de investigación, aplicando la investigación en materia de seguridad al entrenamiento, la evaluación y el despliegue de los modelos.

The People's Bank of China (PBOC) Governor Pan Gongsheng urged a "more comprehensive analytical perspective" regarding global imbalances in a G20 meeting of finance ministers and central bank governors on Thursday in Bangkok, a central bank statement showed.
Pan said attention should be paid not only to the current account, which covers goods and services trade, but also to money flows in financial channels, according to the statement.
Global imbalances cannot be resolved through exchange rate adjustments alone, he said.
Deficit and surplus countries should work in concert to achieve a dynamic equilibrium in the global economy, Pan was quoted as saying.
As China's trade surplus [USN:L6N4600GE TEXT:"surges"], European leaders have intensified calls for a stronger yuan.
The PBOC [USN:L6N45U0ON TEXT:"pushed back"] against foreign criticism of its exchange-rate policy in a statement earlier this month, saying it neither needs nor intends to obtain a trade competitive edge through exchange-rate depreciation.

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India on Thursday issued clarifications on its latest policy measures to support the rupee, following concerns about tighter hedging rules and cash margins on certain derivatives used to protect against a weaker rupee.
items.body:
The Reserve Bank of India on Thursday issued clarifications on its latest policy measures to support the rupee, following concerns about tighter hedging rules and cash margins on certain derivatives used to protect against a weaker rupee.
The RBI has announced a series of measures since October 10, including redirecting oil companies' dollar purchases to a special facility and levying cash reserve requirements on FX hedges for import liabilities and banks' own assets and liabilities.
The measures sparked unintended consequences, with several lenders holding back on quoting dollar-rupee forwards due to confusion over which transactions the cash margin requirement would be levied on.

items.title: Turkey to account for 20% of Europe-CIS new aircraft demand over 20 years, Airbus says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Airbus expects Turkey to account for about 20% of demand for new passenger aircraft in Europe and the CIS over the next 20 years, requiring 1,800 new aircraft as passenger traffic grows, a senior Airbus executive said on Thursday.
items.body:
Airbus (AIR.PA) expects Turkey to account for about 20% of demand for new passenger aircraft in Europe and the CIS over the next 20 years, requiring 1,800 new aircraft as passenger traffic grows, a senior Airbus executive said on Thursday.
Antonio Da Costa, Airbus vice president for market analysis and forecast, said the number of flights taken annually per person in Turkey was expected to triple to 3.1 by 2045, surpassing the regional average of 2.4.
"We expect to see the need for Turkey as a whole, 1,800 new aircraft to renew the fleet and especially grow at the rate that's expected," Da Costa said, adding that passenger traffic in Turkey was expected to grow by around 4.5% annually over the next 20 years, compared with 2.9% for the wider region.
"Our expectation is that the fleet of aircraft in Turkey overall, throughout all the airlines, will more than double over the next 20 years," Da Costa said.
According to Airbus' latest Global Market Forecast, Europe and the CIS region will need 8,190 new passenger aircraft by 2045, including 3,600 for growth and 4,590 for fleet renewal.
Da Costa said Istanbul's position as an international connecting hub continued to strengthen, driven by strong tourism demand and transit traffic.
Asked about the impact of the conflict in the Middle East on aviation demand, Da Costa said Turkey had benefited from traffic diversions away from parts of the Gulf region, attracting more tourists and connecting passengers.
"We do see an opportunity... there's more incoming tourists and more connecting passengers coming through Turkey due to the conflict in the Gulf," he said.
While expecting regional tensions to ease over time, Da Costa said he believed the additional traffic flowing through Turkey would support the country's longer-term growth.

items.title: Italy's political risks cloud debt reduction hopes amid bond turmoil
items.author: Sara Rossi, Valentina Consiglio
items.creator: Sara Rossi, Valentina Consiglio
items.summary: Italy's national election next year throws doubt on Rome's plans to reverse the rise in its huge public debt, analysts say, warning that the strong market appetite for Italian bonds in recent years may be coming to an end.
items.body:
Italy's national election next year throws doubt on Rome's plans to reverse the rise in its huge public debt, analysts say, warning that the strong market appetite for Italian bonds in recent years may be coming to an end.
Italy's €3-trillion ($3.36 trillion) government bond market, one of the world's biggest, has come under renewed scrutiny amid contagion from a sharp selloff in French debt, while domestic political uncertainty mounts and the boost from European Union post-COVID recovery funds fades.
Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has followed a largely prudent fiscal policy, but with her rightist coalition trailing the centre-left in opinion polls, she will be under pressure to open the purse strings [USN:L8N45U0SU TEXT:"ahead of next year's vote"], analysts say.
"We expect fiscal risk premia to continue to build ahead of the election," Filippo Taddei, Senior European Economist at Goldman Sachs, told Reuters.
ITALIAN YIELD SPREAD WIDENS Recent weakness in Italian bonds has been driven by the selloff in France, [USN:L8N45U1VY TEXT:"where a weakened government is trying to pass a budget"] and a key election looms next year, but focus is also turning to Italy's political complications.
The yield on the 10-year bonds (BTPs) of the euro zone's third-largest economy hit 4.7% this month and the yield gap with safe-haven Bunds - a market gauge of the risk premium investors demand to hold Italian debt - reached its widest in almost 18 months.
The BTP yield has risen more than 100 basis points so far this year and is set for the biggest annual jump since 2022, when an inflation surge sparked a rise in interest rates.
[USN:L8N45O0PD TEXT:"Swiss bank UBS"] has recommended that investors go short BTPs, forecasting that the Bund-BTP spread, which was as narrow as 60 basis points in January, will widen to 150 bps. It currently stands at around 105.
A short position is a bet that an asset will weaken in price.
Goldman Sachs' Taddei said Italy's debt-to-GDP ratio, which climbed to 136.7% in 2025, will remain on a rising path at least until 2028, and warned that if 10-year BTP yields remain above 4% the debt will continue to increase in future years.
Higher bond yields mean higher debt-servicing costs. Italian interest spending exceeded €100 billion last year, while average issuance costs rose to 3% in September from 2.75% a year earlier, Treasury data showed.
DEFICIT TO FALL - THEN RISE The government has targeted the budget deficit to fall this year to 2.9% of gross domestic product, just inside the EU's 3% ceiling, [USN:L8N45O0R5 TEXT:"only to rise back above 3%"] in the next two years in order to hike defence spending and tackle surging energy costs.
The picture is not all bleak, however. Growth held up better than expected in the first two quarters and the government this month hiked its full-year 2026 growth forecast to 1% from 0.6%, thanks in large measure to billions of euros of EU post-COVID funds which have lifted investments.
With EU payments under the programme due to end by December, TS Lombard global macro director Davide Oneglia said the country now needed structural reforms, not just fiscal caution.
"Meloni doesn't have a big plan for the economy," he said at a TS Lombard conference last week in London. "Not rocking the boat is not enough and her own political stability is not certain."
Ratings agency Moody's, which a year ago upgraded Italy's sovereign rating to "Baa2" from "Baa3", raised similar concerns in a new report last week.
"Slower growth, reduced fiscal discipline or weaker reform momentum would put the projected debt reduction trajectory at risk," it said.
($1 = 0.8937 euros)

items.title: Polish banks seek state risk-sharing to fund defence build-up
items.author: Marta Maciag
items.creator: Marta Maciag
items.summary: The Polish Bank Association, which represents most of the country’s lenders, is in talks with public institutions to share the risk of financing defence projects, its vice president Agnieszka Wachnicka said on Thursday.
items.body:
The Polish Bank Association, which represents most of the country’s lenders, is in talks with public institutions to share the risk of financing defence projects, its vice president Agnieszka Wachnicka said on Thursday.
Poland has [USN:L8N41L0J2 TEXT:"secured"] €43.7 billion ($49.0 billion) in European SAFE loans targeting the domestic defence industry. It is expected to [USN:L8N42W1SI TEXT:"spend"] around €53 billion on defence in 2026, the fourth-highest in the European Union behind France, Italy and Germany, NATO data shows.
Military technology can become outdated faster than the loans financing it, Wachnicka told Reuters, citing drones as an example
Regulatory limits on banks' exposure to single sectors and regions can also prevent them from taking on more defence projects, Wachnicka said
"SAFE is a big help here ... but it is still not enough," she added
Bank Handlowy (BHW.WA) , Citigroup’s (C.N) Polish unit, has granted significant guarantee lines to defence firms, CEO Elzbieta Czetwertynska said
Czetwertynska said dual-use technology is becoming more important, as private companies look for ways to make large defence investments pay off if demand falls
($1 = 0.8924 euros)

items.title: US wants Senegal debt restructuring wrapped up in less than a year
items.author: Andrea Shalal
items.creator: Andrea Shalal
items.summary: The United States views Senegal's request for debt restructuring as a "great example" of progress on the Group of 20 Common Framework, and wants to see work on the case completed in less than a year, a top US Treasury official said on Thursday.
items.body:
The United States views Senegal's request for debt restructuring as a "great example" of progress on the Group of 20 Common Framework, and wants to see work on the case completed in less than a year, a top US Treasury official said on Thursday.
Erin Browne, Treasury undersecretary for international affairs, co-chaired a [USN:L8N4601AF TEXT:"meeting of the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable"] on Wednesday together with the heads of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank.
The group, which also includes creditors, borrowers and private sector players, released its progress report on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok. It was set up to help speed up treatments under the Common Framework following protracted processes in Zambia and Ghana.
"We've made really good progress in terms of the sovereign debt architecture, particularly with sovereign debt restructurings," Browne told Reuters in an interview.
"We highlight Senegal as a great example of moving forward under the [USN:L6N4570JZ TEXT:"Common Framework sovereign debt restructuring"]."
Senegal is in the midst of a debt treatment that aims to return its finances to a sustainable trajectory.
"We want this done quickly, transparently, and as expeditiously as possible, so that while there's not a clear timeline ... some in the room were saying in less than one year, and I think that that's a goal that we should all be aiming for," Browne said.
IMF Managing Director [USN:S0N43A00E TEXT:"Kristalina Georgieva"] on Wednesday also expressed optimism that Senegal would be able to renegotiate its debts, and said the IMF would support Senegal with a staff-negotiated agreement for a $2.2 billion program.
Browne said the debt roundtable included robust conversation about expanding which countries could seek debt treatments, beyond the poorest countries initially included.
Discussions on that issue would continue next year, Browne said, adding that participants had not discussed names of specific countries at Wednesday's meeting.
Browne said Thursday's meeting of G20 finance ministers went well, touching on issues such as global imbalances, modernizing the global financial system, including through streamlining regulations, and global sovereign debt issues, as well as financial literacy.

FAST

LONDON, Oct 15 : The dollar slipped from an 18-month peak on Thursday as a sharp drop in Treasury yields weighed on the greenback, while cautious remarks from Federal Reserve officials tempered October hike expectations despite hot inflation data. 
The dollar index, which measures the US currency against a basket of peers, was last down 0.2 per cent on the day at 102.03, having hit an 18-month high on Wednesday after US inflation figures came in stronger than expected.
That helped the euro bounce 0.5 per cent from an 18-month trough to $1.1216, putting it on track for its biggest daily gain in nearly two months. Sterling strengthened 0.5 per cent to $1.3253, remaining broadly steady after data showed that Britain's economy unexpectedly grew 0.1 per cent in August. 
Markets turned cautious and trading became somewhat choppy as Wednesday's hot US CPI reading initially bolstered bets on higher-for-longer Fed rates, and worries about AI companies' heavy debt burdens were revived, driving safe-haven flows into Treasuries.

The rally in US government bonds pushed the benchmark 10-year yield to 5.085 per cent while the 30-year yield fell to 5.428 per cent, both at around three-week lows. 
As well as the moves in bond yields and jittery equities, with tech stocks especially taking a hit, Kit Juckes, chief FX strategist at Societe Generale, also noted that shifts in positioning played a role in the dollar's moves.
"The overall picture is I think one of a little bit of a tug of war between people who would like to look for a correction in the dollar. Because positioning's too big, we've come a long way, there's not really much new news, we've got a lot of rate hikes priced in and so on. And then the economic data, which can flip it," he said. 
"I suspect it'll be choppy and uncomfortable until we've got past the retail sales and PPI numbers." 
Both data points are due later in the day, with producer prices expected to show a jump in business costs last month. 
Market pricing for an October Fed rate hike rose sharply to 50 per cent on the back of the CPI data, before a chorus of Fed officials – including Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman and San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly – said the central bank could wait for a clearer picture ahead of the October 27 and 28 meeting, tempering those bets.
"Despite the whole CPI number coming slightly stronger than expected, I think markets have sort of taken the view that maybe it was not hot enough to force the Fed's hand for October," said Khoon Goh, the head of Asia research at ANZ. 
"(The) October (meeting) is also just a few days before the midterm elections as well," he added. "And that's possibly why the market doesn't want to be more aggressive in pricing in for October." 
Investors will also watch remarks from Fed officials including Chair Kevin Warsh at IMF-World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok on Friday for clues on the US central bank's next move. 
The Australian dollar fetched $0.6919, down 0.7 per cent, after local employment unexpectedly slid in September, while the Japanese yen strengthened to 157.80 per dollar.   

Source: Reuters

items.title: US 10-year Treasury yield levels not unprecedented, BNY CEO says
items.author: Saeed Azhar, Arasu Basil
items.creator: Saeed Azhar, Arasu Basil
items.summary: The levels the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield has touched this year are not unprecedented, the CEO of the oldest US bank told Reuters, as a bruising selloff in government debt lifted yields to multi-decade highs.
items.body:
The levels the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield has touched this year are not unprecedented, the CEO of the oldest US bank (BNY.N) told Reuters, as a [USN:L1N45V0NY TEXT:"bruising selloff in government debt"] lifted yields to multi-decade highs.
The 10-year US Treasury yield, a yardstick for global borrowing costs and asset prices, posted its [USN:L8N45N0KW TEXT:"sharpest rise since 1994"] in the July-September period.
"We got 10-year rates to like, call it five and a quarter. There's nothing particularly unusual in history about 10-year rates at that level. We've had arguably low levels for a very long time," BNY CEO Robin Vince told Reuters on Thursday.
"People get very caught up. It has happened quickly, for sure, but with what I would view as more of a normalization of the curve."
BNY's profit applicable to common shareholders jumped 20% to $1.61 billion, or $2.34 per share, in the three months ended September 30, driven by interest income growth and stronger market levels that boosted the value of client assets.
Assets under custody and administration rose 10% to $63.4 trillion in the reported quarter from a year earlier.
Global bond markets have come under intense pressure this year as energy prices remain elevated, while the AI boom is supporting economic growth, a combination that has heightened worries about inflation and rising interest rates.
"You can make a good case that it is actually the strength of the US economy that's one of the primary drivers of inflation and the move higher in rates," Vince said.
A surge in [USN:L1N44D06H TEXT:"debt issuance to fund the artificial intelligence buildout"] has also contributed to the upswing in bond yields.
"There's just more debt in the world. There need to be buyers for that. The supply and demand is going to put upward pressure," Vince said.
[USN:L6N460140 TEXT:"This week's rout in AI stocks"] has, however, eased some pressure on the beaten-down bond markets, with investors flocking to safe-haven government debt in the face of the tech selloff, pushing US yields down across the curve.
The 10-year Treasury yield was [USN:L8N4610QB TEXT:"headed for the largest one-day decline"] since early August 2025 on Thursday.
Asked about the AI trade and the infrastructure buildout, Vince said he would be surprised if there were a glut based on what's been built out so far.
"Will we need the product that those data centers are producing? Will we have a glut? I think the answer is we will need them," Vince said.
[USN:L1N3I80VH TEXT:"BNY has grown into the world's largest custodian"]. The company sits at the center of global capital markets, safeguarding and administering trillions of dollars in client assets, while processing trades and moving securities and cash between financial institutions.
DEPOSITS EXPECTED TO PICK UP IN Q4 In a statement, Vince said that client demand is continuing to grow and BNY's sales and pipelines remain very healthy across products and regions.
Average deposits are expected to pick up in the fourth quarter along with client activity, Chief Financial Officer Dermot McDonogh told Reuters.
The New York-based firm is also benefiting from a rise in interest rates as it reinvests cash from maturing investment securities at higher yields.
Net interest income — the spread between earnings from assets and costs on liabilities — accounts for roughly 25% of BNY's revenue, McDonogh said.

items.title: Lufthansa está em negociações para comprar os 50,1% restantes das ações da TAP no futuro, diz CFO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Estão ocorrendo negociações separadas sobre a possibilidade de a Lufthansa adquirir, no futuro, os 50,1% restantes da participação majoritária na companhia aérea portuguesa TAP, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o diretor financeiro da Lufthansa.
items.body:
Estão ocorrendo negociações separadas sobre a possibilidade de a Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) adquirir, no futuro, os 50,1% restantes da participação majoritária na companhia aérea portuguesa TAP, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o diretor financeiro da Lufthansa.
Nesse processo, o governo português poderia se tornar acionista da Lufthansa com uma participação de até 5%, disse o diretor financeiro Till Streichert.
Na quarta-feira, o governo português escolheu a Lufthansa para adquirir uma participação de até 49,9% na TAP Air Portugal por 1,2 bilhão de euros (US$1,35 bilhão), em detrimento da rival Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) .
O negócio, que vem sendo negociado há anos e sofreu repetidos atrasos, é o próximo passo na consolidação do setor aéreo europeu.
Streichert disse que espera que o negócio seja fechado no primeiro semestre de 2028 e gere 450 milhões de euros em sinergias.
O presidente-executivo da Lufthansa, Carsten Spohr, disse aos jornalistas que o negócio era “uma combinação perfeita” para o grupo.
A Lufthansa já é proprietária da Austrian Airlines, da ITA Airways e da SWISS, entre outras companhias aéreas.
Ele disse que seria uma transação mais fácil de ser aprovada pela União Europeia do que a da italiana ITA, cuja reestruturação ainda está em andamento, já que há menos sobreposição de negócios com a Lufthansa.
(Reportagem de Klaus Lauer)

items.title: EU-backed east Mediterranean undersea cable project applies to resume seabed research, Greece says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Greece said on Thursday the developer of an EU-backed undersea power cable scheme in the eastern Mediterranean has applied for a licence to resume seabed surveying, key for the long-delayed project to move ahead.
items.body:
Greece said on Thursday the developer of an EU-backed undersea power cable scheme in the eastern Mediterranean has applied for a licence to resume seabed surveying, key for the long-delayed project to move ahead.
Construction of the Great Sea Interconnector (GSI) aims to link the European mainland to Cyprus and later Israel, but is opposed by Turkey.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Athens last week said the US was [USN:L6N45U0PA TEXT:""very committed""] to the project as it promotes energy supply diversification, necessary due to Russia's war in Ukraine and the situation in the Strait of Hormuz.
Greece's power grid operator IPTO (ADMr.AT) is developing the €1.9 billion ($2.13 billion) scheme. French company Nexans (NEXS.PA) , the cable contractor, has on behalf of the GSI applied for a Greek permit to survey the seabed, Greek government spokesperson Pavlos Marinakis told reporters on Thursday.
Progress on the project has been slow amid a dispute between Greece and Turkey over the maritime area that will be designated for laying down the cable.
Greece hopes to resume seabed surveying to determine the route soon, a move Turkey says would need prior coordination between the two countries as it crosses an area under a 2019 maritime deal with Libya, which Athens has rejected.
Marinakis said surveying will be carried out by a French ship and would start after a Greek ministerial committee in charge of permitting marine research in Greek maritime zones and the Greek coast guard approve the request.
"With regards to the project implementation, Greece has not made arrangements with the authorities of any state other than France and Cyprus — which is the obvious case," Marinakis said.
Rubio said last week that the US will use diplomacy to try to remove any possible hurdles.
($1 = 0.8917 euros)

items.title: La guerre au Moyen-Orient aura un impact durable sur le commerce - directrice OMC
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Les conflits en Ukraine et au Moyen-Orient ainsi que les bouleversements géopolitiques en cours auront un impact durable sur le commerce mondial, a dit jeudi à Reuters Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, directrice générale de l'Organisation mondiale du commerce (OMC).
items.body:
Les conflits en Ukraine et au Moyen-Orient ainsi que les bouleversements géopolitiques en cours auront un impact durable sur le commerce mondial, a dit jeudi à Reuters Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, directrice générale de l'Organisation mondiale du commerce (OMC).
Au Moyen-Orient, les échanges commerciaux se sont fortement contractés depuis que Etats-Unis et Israël ont déclenché une guerre contre l'Iran fin février - et ce malgré une série de solutions de contournement.
Leur reprise prendra du temps, a estimé Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala lors d'une interview en marge des réunions annuelles du Fonds monétaire international et de la Banque mondiale organisées à Bangkok, ajoutant que certains changements pourraient devenir permanents.
L'OMC prévoit une baisse de 17% des exportations en provenance du Moyen-Orient cette année et un repli de quelque 15% des importations.
Des experts du secteur tablaient au début du conflit sur un retour à la normale des flux commerciaux une fois la guerre terminée et le détroit d'Ormuz rouvert, par lequel transite en temps normal 20% du trafic maritime mondial d'hydrocarbures.
Mais, depuis, la durée du conflit a souligné la nécessité d'une diversification et certaines des routes commerciales alternatives devraient perdurer, a poursuivi Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.
"Nous constatons que le monde des doit réfléchir à des goulets d'étranglement (tels que le détroit d'Ormuz)", a-t-elle encore dit.
"Je pense que certaines de ces alternatives resteront en place car les pays tout comme les entreprises voudront se prémunir contre toute éventualité", a déclaré la directrice générale de l'OMC.
Elle dit ainsi s'attendre à une poursuite voire à une amplification des efforts de diversification vers différents pays.
Comme autre choc pesant sur les échanges commerciaux, Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala a cité la multiplication des droits de douane imposés par le président américain Donald Trump depuis son retour au pouvoir en janvier 2025.
"Il ne fait absolument aucun doute que les chaînes d'approvisionnement ont été réorganisées," a-t-elle déclaré, ajoutant que les chefs d'entreprise ont fait preuve de créativité pour trouver de nouvelles routes commerciales, avec le bémol qu'elles s'avèrent plus coûteuses.
UNE OPPORTUNITÉ POUR LE COMMERCE INTRA-AFRICAIN Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala a également souligné le potentiel de croissance du commerce intra-africain.
"Les échanges entre Africains peuvent véritablement créer de la valeur et générer des emplois," a-t-elle déclaré, précisant que le commerce intra-africain représentait désormais environ 20% du commerce africain.
A titre de comparaison, les échanges au sein de l'Union européenne représentaient environ 60% du total de ses échanges commerciaux.
L'OMC a relevé la semaine dernière ses prévisions de croissance du commerce mondial de marchandises, la demande de produits liés à l'intelligence artificielle (IA) devant compenser l’impact des perturbations provoquées par la guerre au Moyen-Orient.
La croissance du volume du commerce mondial de marchandises devrait atteindre 3,9% en 2026, contre un chiffre de +1,9% retenu dans les prévisions de l'OMC publiées en [USN:L6N40712R TEXT:"mars"].
Selon Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, l'avenir reste incertain compte tenu des conflits en cours, des droits de douane et des craintes que l'essor de l'IA ne s'essouffle voire ne retombe.
"L'impact de l'IA masque les autres tendances du commerce, qui ne sont pas positives," a-t-elle déclaré.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ucrania exportó 1,125 millones de toneladas métricas de productos agrícolas entre el 1 y el 13 de octubre, lo que supone el 50% del volumen de exportación potencial, dijo el jueves el ministro de Agricultura, Taras Vysotskyi.
items.body:
Ucrania exportó 1,125 millones de toneladas métricas de productos agrícolas entre el 1 y el 13 de octubre, lo que supone el 50% del volumen de exportación potencial, dijo el jueves el ministro de Agricultura, Taras Vysotskyi.
Señaló que dicho volumen incluía 670.000 toneladas de cereales, 138.000 toneladas de aceite vegetal y 184.000 toneladas de semillas oleaginosas.
Las exportaciones alimentarias ucranianas han caído drásticamente desde finales de julio, después de que sus principales puertos del mar Negro quedaran bloqueados por los ataques rusos.

items.title: Ucrânia retoma ataques a refinarias russas e Zelenskiy critica EUA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Ucrânia retomou seus ataques a refinarias russas com um ataque a uma instalação na região de Ryazan, informou o governador regional nesta quinta-feira, depois que o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy expressou sua indignação com uma “perigosa” retirada dos serviços de inteligência dos EUA.
items.body:
A Ucrânia retomou seus ataques a refinarias russas com um ataque a uma instalação na região de Ryazan, informou o governador regional nesta quinta-feira, depois que o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy expressou sua indignação com uma “perigosa” retirada dos serviços de inteligência dos EUA.
Desde o anúncio surpresa do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, sobre um cessar-fogo energético entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia no domingo, Kiev havia se abstido de ataques às refinarias russas, aos quais o líder norte-americano atribuíra a responsabilidade pelo aumento dos preços do diesel nos mercados globais.
Mas Zelenskiy vinha manifestando crescente frustração com os contínuos ataques da Rússia à infraestrutura energética ucraniana, que, segundo ele, deixaram 600 mil pessoas sem energia elétrica na quarta-feira. Ele alertou que a Ucrânia não suspenderia seus próprios ataques indefinidamente se a Rússia não fizesse o mesmo e também criticou o que considerou ser o favoritismo de Trump em relação à Rússia.
Em entrevista ao Financial Times publicada na quinta-feira, ele afirmou que a paciência da Ucrânia havia se esgotado.
“A restrição (ao ataque a refinarias) acabou. Chega”, disse ele ao jornal.
Pavel Malkov, governador de Ryazan, afirmou em uma postagem no Telegram que um grande ataque ucraniano com drones na região havia provocado um incêndio em uma refinaria de petróleo.
“Os danos materiais estão sendo avaliados neste momento. As equipes de emergência estão trabalhando no local”, disse ele.
Em sua entrevista, Zelenskiy criticou a ânsia de Washington em fechar acordos comerciais com Moscou e a aparente admiração de Trump pelo russo Vladimir Putin.
No sábado, Trump pediu que a Ucrânia substituísse Zelenskiy e criticou veementemente os ataques ucranianos à infraestrutura petrolífera russa, um dia após anunciar um acordo de fornecimento de diesel com a Rússia, com o objetivo de reduzir os preços dos combustíveis, que dispararam desde o início da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, em fevereiro.
Apesar da suspensão dos ataques a refinarias por parte da Ucrânia, autoridades ucranianas reclamaram que não haviam recebido nenhum alerta antecipado dos EUA nos últimos dias sobre mísseis balísticos russos a caminho.
Eles também afirmaram que a versão militar do serviço de comunicações via satélite Starlink, de Elon Musk, teve sua velocidade reduzida em todo o país, prejudicando as operações na linha de frente e os ataques de médio alcance contra alvos militares russos.
Musk afirmou na quarta-feira, em uma postagem no X, que o Starshield — a versão militar do Starlink — era de propriedade e controle do governo dos EUA, que decidia sobre quaisquer limites de velocidade.
Zelenskiy afirmou que oficiais militares ucranianos foram avisados por seus homólogos norte-americanos de que Washington bloquearia o acesso a informações de inteligência, a menos que suspendessem os ataques à infraestrutura energética russa.
Na entrevista ao FT, Zelenskiy disse que a suspensão foi apresentada a Kiev como uma falha técnica, mas descartou a ideia de que as falhas no sistema de satélites Starlink pudessem ter sido causadas por um problema técnico.
“Não foi um problema técnico, foi uma decisão deliberada”, disse ele ao FT.

items.title: POINT MARCHÉS Les craintes sur la dette liée à l'IA bousculent à nouveau les Bourses mondiales
items.author: Diana Mandia
items.creator: Diana Mandia
items.summary: Wall Street est attendue en ordre dispersé et les Bourses européennes évoluent également dans le désordre jeudi à mi-séance, les inquiétudes sur le niveau d'endettement des entreprises liées à l'intelligence artificielle (IA) refaisant surface et poussant les investisseurs vers les valeurs refuge.
items.body:
Wall Street est attendue en ordre dispersé et les Bourses européennes évoluent également dans le désordre jeudi à mi-séance, les inquiétudes sur le niveau d'endettement des entreprises liées à l'intelligence artificielle (IA) refaisant surface et poussant les investisseurs vers les valeurs refuge.
Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture en hausse de 0,26% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , mais en baisse de 0,29% pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et de 1,22% pour le Nasdaq.
À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) prend 0,16% à 7.885,75 points vers 11h14 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) recule de 0,47% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) avance de 0,57%.
L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) perd 0,88%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) 0,23% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) 0,25%.
Le coût de l'assurance contre les défauts de paiement des géants technologiques américains atteignent jeudi des niveaux record, un nouveau signe des tensions croissantes sur le marché du crédit dans le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA), qui touchent particulièrement les opérateurs de centres de données, dont la rentabilité dépend des revenus futurs.
L'un d'entre eux, le groupe américain CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , doit près de 50 milliards de dollars à ses créanciers, selon les données de LSEG, et a chuté mercredi de 15% à la Bourse de New York, ce qui lui a fait perdre un cinquième de sa capitalisation boursière.
Le rendement des obligations à échéance 2031 de CoreWeave a bondi jeudi à 16,4%, selon Tradeweb, une plateforme de trading électronique, tandis que le coût de l'assurance contre la dette du groupe a grimpé au-delà de 1.000 points de base pour atteindre des niveaux records, montrent les données de S&P Global Market Intelligence.
L'onde de choc sur les marchés du crédit du secteur touche également Oracle (ORCL.N) , Amazon (AMZN.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Meta (META.O) et Nvidia (NVDA.O) .
L'action CoreWeave et celles des géants de la "tech" américaine devraient continuer à souffrir jeudi, selon les indications en avant-Bourse, et la vague de ventes s'étend, dans le même temps, aux [USN:L6N4610JN TEXT:"marchés européens"] après avoir également touché les asiatiques pendant la nuit.
L'indice des nouvelles technologies sur le Stoxx 6000 (.SX8P) recule de 3,08%, après être tombé en séance à son plus bas niveau depuis plus de trois semaines, à 998,99 points.
Si les inquiétudes concernant l'endettement élevé du secteur, en pleine course à l'IA, ne sont pas nouvelles, les chiffres de l'inflation américaine du mois de septembre les ont encore exacerbées, car une politique monétaire plus restrictive de la Réserve fédérale (Fed) pour y remédier aurait pour effet d'augmenter les coûts de financement des entreprises.
Ces difficultés poussent les investisseurs à se détourner du risque et à se réfugier dans les obligations d'État, ce qui entraîne une hausse de leurs cours et une baisse de leurs rendements, qui avaient récemment atteint des sommets inégalés depuis plus de deux décennies.
Les chiffres de l'inflation américaine ont une nouvelle fois bouleversé les anticipations des marchés financiers, qui estiment désormais à 50% la probabilité d'une hausse des taux en octobre, une hypothèse qui avait été écartée ces dernières semaines.
Le président de la banque centrale américaine, Kevin Warsh, prendra la parole à Bangkok dans la nuit de jeudi à vendredi à l'occasion de la réunion annuelle du FMI qui se tient dans la capitale thaïlandaise, une dernière occasion d'influencer les anticipations avant la décision de politique monétaire prévue dans moins de deux semaines.
La séance du jour est par ailleurs marquée par de nombreux indicateurs économiques aux Etats-Unis, dont les ventes au détail, les inscriptions au chômage et les prix à la production (PPI).
LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L8N4610PD]
VALEURS EN EUROPE Les actions des fabricants européens de puces électroniques et des groupes liés à l'IA chutent fortement jeudi, ASML (ASML.AS) , STMicroelectronics (STMPA.PA) , BESI (BESI.AS) , Infineon (IFXGn.DE) et ASMI (ASMI.AS) reculant de 5,3% à 8,3%.
Legrand (LEGD.PA) et Schneider Electric (SCHN.PA) , dont l'activité est très dépendante des centres de données, enregistrent des baisses respectives de 4,2 et de 3,7% à Paris.
Dans le reste de l'actualité des entreprises, Pernod Ricard (PERP.PA) avance légèrement (+0,97%) après avoir fait état d'une baisse moins importante que prévu de son chiffre d'affaires du premier trimestre.
TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) , qui a déclaré s'attendre à ce que son bénéfice du troisième trimestre soit porté par un quasi-quadruplage des marges de raffinage et par une forte hausse des revenus liés au gaz naturel liquéfié (GNL), prend 0,99%.
Le fabricant d'équipements télécoms Ericsson (ERICb.ST) grimpe de plus de 9% après avoir publié un bénéfice d'exploitation trimestriel avec une baisse moins marquée qu'initialement anticipé.
Tomtom (TOM2.AS) perd 2,88%, le spécialiste néerlandais de la cartographie numérique ayant annoncé son intention de réorganiser ses activités, ce qui affectera environ 200 postes dans le monde.
TAUX Les rendements obligataires sont en nette baisse jeudi dans un contexte d'aversion au risque.
Aux Etats-Unis, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans perd 10,7 points de base à 5,0829% et est en passe d'enregistrer sa plus forte baisse journalière depuis début août 2025. Celui du titre à deux ans recule de 6,8 points de base à 4,7340%.
Dans la zone euro, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans cède 10 points de base à 3,3664%, celui de l'obligation à deux ans abandonne 6 points de base à 3,0401%.
En France, le taux de rendement de l'OAT à dix ans perd 12,5 points de base pour s'établir à 4,7553%.
Les anticipations concernant l'évolution des taux de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) restent globalement inchangées, les marchés monétaires tablant sur un statu quo en octobre avant une nouvelle hausse en décembre.
Selon Alvaro Santos Pereira, membre du conseil des gouverneurs de l'institution de Francfort, [USN:L6N4610KY TEXT:"l'inflation"] liée aux prix de l'énergie ne se répercute pas sur les autres prix, ce qui constitue un signe rassurant.
Au Royaume-Uni, Huw Pill, chef économiste de la Banque d'Angleterre (BoE), [USN:L6N4610LI TEXT:"a dit"] jeudi qu'un possible relèvement des taux ne devait pas être interprété comme le début d'une longue série de hausses.
La BoE devrait relever son taux directeur en novembre pour la première fois depuis plus de trois ans, le portant à 4%, selon la majorité des économistes interrogés par Reuters.
CHANGES Le dollar recule jeudi par rapport à son plus haut niveau depuis 18 mois atteint la veille, la forte baisse des rendements des bons du Trésor pesant sur la devise américaine.
Le billet vert perd 0,48% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro gagne 0,51% à 1,1213 dollar .
PÉTROLE Les prix du pétrole évoluent sur de faibles variations, les investisseurs examinant les perspectives d'approvisionnement et les [USN:L6N4600N9 TEXT:"tensions persistantes"] au Moyen-Orient.
Le Brent recule de 1,3% à 104,68 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) 0,06% à 95,03 dollars.
Les opérateurs analysent également les plans des Etats-Unis visant [USN:L6N461003 TEXT:"à alléger"] les sanctions contre les navires de la "flotte fantôme", qui transportent du pétrole en provenance de Russie, d'Iran ou du Venezuela, afin de faire baisser les taux de fret mondiaux.
Les répercussions des perturbations du trafic maritime dans le détroit d'Ormuz commencent par ailleurs à se faire sentir sur les récoltes agricoles, menaçant de faire baisser les rendements et de faire grimper les prix des denrées alimentaires, [USN:L6N4610ND TEXT:"a déclaré"] jeudi à Reuters le directeur d'une agence des Nations unies chargée du développement rural.

items.title: India's Tech Mahindra second-quarter revenue beats estimate
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's Tech Mahindra on Thursday beat second-quarter revenue expectations, helped by steady growth in its manufacturing and communications verticals and a weak rupee.
items.body:
India's Tech Mahindra (TEML.NS) on Thursday beat second-quarter revenue expectations, helped by steady growth in its manufacturing and communications verticals and a weak rupee.
The IT services company also said it would issue bonus shares worth up to 4.9 billion rupees, the first time it has done so since 2015.
Consolidated revenue rose 15.6% to 161.80 billion rupees ($1.70 billion) year-on-year. Analysts, on average, expected revenue of 151.95 billion rupees, as per data compiled by LSEG.
Analysts had expected Tech Mahindra to post one of the fastest revenue growth rates among large-cap IT services companies in the quarter, driven by large deal ramp-ups from clients including telecommunications provider Orange Business.
The firm reported a 32.7% year-on-year rise in profit to 15.86 billion rupees, missing estimates of 17.08 billion rupees.
The communications division's revenue, which accounts for a third of the Pune-based company's total, rose 9.5% year-on-year. Revenue from its manufacturing division, its second-largest, grew 7%.
Revenue from the Tech Mahindra's banking and financial services segment, which the company has been pushing to expand in recent quarters, was up 4.6%.
New deal wins in the quarter stood at $1.02 billion, up from $816 million in the same quarter last year.
Larger peers [USN:L4N45U0R3 TEXT:"TCS"] (TCS.NS) and [USN:L4N45Y0P5 TEXT:"HCLTech"] (HCLT.NS) reported their results earlier in the month, while [USN:L4N4610ZD TEXT:"Wipro"] (WIPR.NS) reported higher quarterly revenue earlier in the day.
($1 = 95.0550 Indian rupees)

items.title: Expana rebaja sus previsiones para la cosecha de maíz de la UE a un nuevo mínimo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Expana rebajó su previsión para la cosecha de maíz de la Unión Europea de este año, afectada por las olas de calor y la sequía del verano boreal, a un nuevo mínimo desde la década de los noventa, informó el jueves la empresa especializada en datos sobre materias primas.
items.body:
Expana rebajó su previsión para la cosecha de maíz de la Unión Europea de este año, afectada por las olas de calor y la sequía del verano boreal, a un nuevo mínimo desde la década de los noventa, informó el jueves la empresa especializada en datos sobre materias primas.
La producción de maíz de la UE para la campaña 2026/27 se sitúa ahora en 44,9 millones de toneladas métricas, frente a los 46,2 millones previstos el mes pasado.
Expana había señalado que su previsión anterior marcaba el nivel más bajo desde 1992, pero no ofreció una comparación con respecto a su nueva proyección.
Los datos de la Organización de las Naciones Unidas para la Alimentación y la Agricultura (FAO) revelaron que la nueva estimación representaría la cifra más baja desde 1990.
Se espera que el déficit de producción reduzca el uso de maíz en la alimentación del ganado en la UE durante la campaña 2026/27 en 8 millones de toneladas, es decir, un 13,5%, en comparación con el promedio de los últimos cinco años, según Expana.
La UE también dependerá de importantes importaciones de maíz, y la interrupción de los envíos procedentes de Ucrania —su principal proveedor— a causa de la guerra supone un reto adicional, señaló.
A pesar de la disponibilidad de suministros procedentes de Estados Unidos y Brasil, la UE podría seguir necesitando 11 millones de toneladas de maíz ucraniano, más que los 9,1 millones que importó de Ucrania la temporada pasada, según sus previsiones.
En cuanto al trigo blando, el principal cultivo cerealístico de la UE, Expana mantuvo sin cambios su estimación de producción para la campaña 2026/27 en 126,1 millones de toneladas, lo que supone un descenso del 8% con respecto a la temporada pasada.

items.title: Why are credit default swaps unnerving AI investors?
items.author: Amanda Cooper
items.creator: Amanda Cooper
items.summary: The cost of insuring against the risk of potential US tech defaults has hit record levels in the latest sign of credit stress building in the so-called AI trade, especially for data centres dependent on future revenue.
items.body:
The cost of insuring against the risk of potential US tech defaults has hit record levels in the latest sign of credit stress building in the so-called AI trade, especially for data centres dependent on future revenue.
Although shares in companies driving the AI boom are still among the biggest gainers on global equity markets this year, many have [USN:L6N4601B1 TEXT:"fallen"] sharply in the past few weeks, as investors reassess the cost of capital against a backdrop of rising [USN:L1N45A09M TEXT:"interest rates"] and [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"inflation"].
There are also doubts among some investors and analysts about when, and in some cases, if, the billions of dollars pouring into data centres, computer power and other infrastructure will pay off.
Demand for AI-linked credit default swaps (CDS), a form of insurance against default that gained prominence during the 2008 financial crisis, meanwhile has [USN:L1N46104Z TEXT:"surged"], even for heavyweights like Apple (AAPL.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) and Microsoft (MSFT.O) .
For some of their more heavily indebted competitors, suppliers and customers the cost of CDS has risen even faster.
WHAT IS A CDS? A derivative that provides protection against the risk that a bond issuer, whether a company or government, fails to meet its debt obligations.
Bond investors expect to receive interest payments and repayment of principal when a bond matures, but they bear the risk that those payments may not be made.
Buying CDS helps investors hedge that risk by effectively providing insurance against a default or other credit event. If the value of a bond drops for any reason, an investor might add to their CDS holdings to help offset that, for example.
None of the companies whose CDS have risen recently have defaulted on their obligations or signalled that they may do so.
IS THIS A BIG MARKET? The market for single-name CDS, which cover the bonds of a single issuer, is worth about $9 trillion, the International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) said.
That is a small portion of global bond markets, which have more than $150 trillion of debt securities outstanding, Bank for International Settlements data shows.
The biggest CDS market is for government debt.
Average daily CDS trading across the market was $16 billion in the second quarter, up from $13 billion a year earlier, the most recent data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation shows. Saudi Arabia is the most actively traded.
But average daily trades, even for large companies, can sometimes be in the single digits, meaning small transactions can have an outsized impact on prices.
WHO BUYS CDS? Bond investors typically buy CDS through an intermediary, often an investment bank, which then finds a financial firm to issue an insurance policy on the bonds. These are "over-the-counter" deals that do not go through a central clearing house.
Hedge funds also [USN:L4N3WQ17U TEXT:"participate in the market"], selling CDS to investors seeking to hedge exposure.
The buyer pays a fee, called a premium, at regular intervals to the seller, which assumes the risk of a credit event.
CDS are quoted as a credit spread, which is the number of basis points (bps) that the seller of the derivative charges the buyer for providing protection. The higher the perceived risk of a credit event, the wider the spread.
A CDS quoted at 100 bps costs $1 annually to insure every $100 of debt.
WHAT'S GOING ON WITH TECH CDS? CDS for [USN:L4N4601XL TEXT:"CoreWeave"] (CRWV.O) , a heavily indebted data centre operator at the eye of the current storm, have risen above 1,000 bps, S&P Global Market Intelligence data show.
They suggest a roughly 63% chance of a default over the next five years, up from around 30% a year ago.
Tech CDS moves reflect investor concern over how quickly massive investments in AI will translate into profits, and whether heavily indebted companies can generate returns fast enough to service mounting interest costs.
Oracle (ORCL.N) has seen its CDS trade at nearly 300 bps, well above those of other AI-linked companies.
Nvidia (NVDA.O) CDS have also risen sharply in recent weeks to around 90 bps, Meta CDS (META.O) are trading around 104 bps.
By comparison, an index of investment-grade CDS is trading around 60 bps .
WHAT TRIGGERS A CDS PAYOUT? A CDS pays out following a credit event, which can include a bankruptcy or a failure by an issuer to make bond payments.
When concerns about an issuer's creditworthiness increase, demand for protection typically rises, widening CDS spreads.
Payouts are not a given. When Swiss lender Credit Suisse collapsed and was taken over by rival UBS in 2023, the EMEA Credit Derivatives Determinations Committee (CDDC) ruled that event would not trigger a CDS payout.
IF IT'S INSURANCE, WHAT'S THE PROBLEM? CDS provide a hedge for bondholders. But rising perceived risk pushes up the cost of protection, which can prompt investors to sell bonds and raise borrowing costs for issuers.
That can amplify concerns about creditworthiness and potentially create a self-reinforcing cycle.

items.title: Superficie dedicada al trigo blando en la UE podría reducirse un 2% en próxima cosecha, dice Expana
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La superficie cosechada de trigo blando en la Unión Europea el próximo año disminuiría un 2% en comparación con la cosecha de 2026, ya que los agricultores se enfrentan a unos costos de producción cada vez mayores, informó el jueves la empresa de datos sobre materias primas Expana.
items.body:
La superficie cosechada de trigo blando en la Unión Europea el próximo año disminuiría un 2% en comparación con la cosecha de 2026, ya que los agricultores se enfrentan a unos costos de producción cada vez mayores, informó el jueves la empresa de datos sobre materias primas Expana.
Aunque no facilitó una cifra concreta de superficie, la estimación porcentual sugiere que la superficie dedicada al trigo blando descendería hasta unos 21 millones de hectáreas, frente a los 21,4 millones de hectáreas que Expana estimó para la cosecha de este año.
En un informe, la empresa señaló que "las previsiones de siembra de trigo blando no parecen prometedoras, ya que las perspectivas se ven lastradas por los elevados costos de producción".
Los agricultores se han enfrentado a unos costos cada vez mayores de la energía y los fertilizantes, impulsados por las perturbaciones causadas por la guerra de Irán.
No obstante, la necesidad de sustituir algunos cultivos de colza afectados por la sequía podría contribuir a mantener la superficie dedicada al trigo blando, añadió.
En sus previsiones iniciales sobre la siembra de cereales en la UE, también anticipó que la superficie dedicada a la cebada de invierno se ampliaría a expensas de la cebada de primavera, mientras que se esperaba que la superficie dedicada al maíz siguiera disminuyendo.
