items.title: Gobierno De la Espriella busca desfinanciar terroristas limitando el uso de efectivo Gobierno De la Espriella busca desfinanciar terroristas limitando el uso de efectivo
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: El proyecto de Estatuto Antiterrorista contempla restringir los pagos en efectivo en compras de alto valor para dificultar el lavado de activos y la financiación del terrorismo.
items.body: Bogotá — El Gobierno de Abelardo De la Espriella busca cerrarles el paso a los recursos que financian el terrorismo mediante restricciones al uso de efectivo en operaciones de alto valor, como la compra de viviendas, vehículos y lotes. La propuesta hace parte del proyecto de Estatuto Antiterrorista que el Ejecutivo anunció que llevará al Congreso y apunta a que determinadas transacciones pasen por el sistema financiero, donde pueden dejar registros que faciliten el rastreo del dinero. “El sector financiero colombiano celebra que el Gobierno Nacional estudie limitar los pagos en efectivo en compras de alto valor como parte del Estatuto Antiterrorista”, afirmó Jonathan Malagón, presidente de Asobancaria. El dirigente gremial señaló que las operaciones de compra de apartamentos , carros y lotes deben contar con mecanismos para rastrear el origen de los recursos. La iniciativa plantea una discusión sobre el papel del efectivo en la economía colombiana y las herramientas disponibles para combatir el lavado de activos y la financiación del terrorismo. Sin embargo, todavía deben conocerse los umbrales, las operaciones cobijadas y las excepciones que establecería el texto definitivo. La propuesta contempla que determinadas compras de alto valor deban pagarse mediante canales del sistema financiero, en lugar de entregar directamente billetes entre comprador y vendedor. Esto permitiría generar registros de las transacciones y facilitar la verificación del origen y el movimiento de los recursos. El alcance de la medida dependerá de la versión del proyecto que se presente al Congreso y de los cambios que pueda tener durante su discusión legislativa. Por ahora, no se conocen con precisión los montos a partir de los cuales se aplicarían las restricciones ni todas las operaciones que quedarían incluidas. La iniciativa se enmarca en una estrategia más amplia de trazabilidad financiera que, según el borrador conocido públicamente, también contempla mecanismos relacionados con personas y organizaciones incluidas en un registro de actores terroristas, minerales y activos virtuales. El objetivo es facilitar la identificación de operaciones y recursos vinculados con actividades criminales. No obstante, la propuesta no equivale a una prohibición general del efectivo en Colombia ni significa que las restricciones ya estén vigentes. Augusto Acosta, exsuperintendente financiero de Colombia, considera que canalizar determinadas operaciones por el sistema financiero puede ayudar a fortalecer los controles sobre los recursos. “Todo lo que obligue de alguna forma a que ciertos movimientos se tramiten a través de los canales institucionales del sector financiero, ayuda sin duda ninguna al control de todas las operaciones”, explicó. Acosta señaló que la trazabilidad es una de las principales diferencias entre las transacciones realizadas mediante entidades financieras y aquellas que se hacen directamente en efectivo. En su opinión, los registros bancarios ofrecen mayores posibilidades de seguimiento para las autoridades. El exsuperintendente también advirtió sobre la dependencia del efectivo en Colombia. Según las cifras que mencionó, entre 70% y 75% del Producto Interno Bruto se movería en efectivo. El tamaño de esa economía plantea un desafío para el diseño de la medida: establecer restricciones suficientemente amplias para dificultar las operaciones ilícitas, sin imponer límites que resulten excesivamente restrictivos para las transacciones legítimas. “Vistos todos los montos que se transan en todo este cuento, tampoco puede uno pensar en poner unos montos demasiado restrictivos”, señaló Acosta. El exfuncionario aclaró que no existe una regla que permita definir con claridad cuál debería ser el monto adecuado. Las restricciones al efectivo no son exclusivas de Colombia. Distintos países combinan límites para determinadas operaciones, obligaciones de identificación y reportes a las autoridades tributarias o financieras. Los modelos varían según el tipo de transacción y las condiciones de cada jurisdicción. En México, la legislación contra el lavado de dinero establece límites al uso de efectivo en operaciones específicas. Para la compraventa de inmuebles, el umbral señalado es de 8.025 unidades de medida y actualización (UMA), mientras que para vehículos es de 3.210 UMA. Argentina, por su parte, contempla en la Ley 25.345 que ciertos pagos por encima de los montos legales deben realizarse mediante instrumentos como transferencias, depósitos bancarios o tarjetas. En Estados Unidos no existe una prohibición general de los pagos en efectivo superiores a US$10.000. Sin embargo, las empresas deben reportar al Servicio de Impuestos Internos (IRS) los pagos en efectivo que superen ese monto cuando se reciben en una transacción o en operaciones relacionadas, mediante el formulario 8300. España establece un límite de 1.000 euros para pagos en efectivo cuando alguna de las partes actúa como empresario o profesional. Para particulares sin domicilio fiscal en el país que no actúen profesionalmente, el límite es de 10.000 euros. En Francia, el tope general para pagos en efectivo a empresas es de 1.000 euros para residentes fiscales franceses y de 15.000 euros para no residentes, con reglas distintas para operaciones entre particulares. Alemania no tiene un límite general para los pagos en efectivo, pero exige identificar al comprador y documentar sus datos en determinadas operaciones comerciales de 10.000 euros o más. Brasil, en cambio, exige reportar a la autoridad tributaria ciertas operaciones pagadas en efectivo por valores iguales o superiores a R$30.000. En la Unión Europea, desde julio de 2027 se aplicará un límite general de 10.000 euros para pagos en efectivo en las operaciones comprendidas por la nueva normativa, con excepciones para ciertas transacciones entre particulares. Las experiencias internacionales muestran que limitar el efectivo no implica necesariamente prohibir todas las transacciones por encima de una cifra. Algunos países restringen determinados pagos, mientras otros se concentran en identificar a los compradores o reportar operaciones a las autoridades. Para Colombia, la discusión central será definir qué bienes y transacciones quedarían cobijados, cuál sería el umbral y qué excepciones se establecerían. Esas decisiones determinarán el alcance práctico de la propuesta y las obligaciones que tendrían compradores, vendedores y entidades financieras. La trazabilidad puede facilitar la detección de movimientos sospechosos, pero su efectividad dependerá también de los mecanismos de supervisión y de la capacidad de las autoridades para utilizar la información disponible. El proyecto de Estatuto Antiterrorista deberá pasar por el Congreso antes de convertirse en una obligación legal.

items.title: India says first phase of US trade deal nearly done, insists on edge over rivals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The first phase of an India-US trade deal is in the final stages of drafting, India's trade minister said on Thursday, but reiterated that New Delhi would proceed only if it secures an advantage over competing exporters.
items.body:
The first phase of an India-US trade deal is in the final stages of drafting, India's trade minister said on Thursday, but reiterated that New Delhi would proceed only if it secures an advantage over competing exporters.
New Delhi and Washington agreed to a framework for the deal in February which brought down to 18% from 50% the punitive tariff on most Indian goods imposed in August last year after a previous round of talks collapsed.
Since then, negotiations have run into [USN:L4N45S0BG TEXT:"hurdles"], with officials on both sides signalling that efforts to reach a final agreement have slowed.
Indian trade minister Piyush Goyal said the "first tranche" of the deal would be finalised soon.
"It's going through the final contours, the legal drafting, and we hope to be able to finalise that soon and operationalise that once we get comparable advantage or competitive advantage over our peer countries," a statement from his office quoted him as saying at an event in New Delhi.
Goyal was referring to New Delhi's efforts to secure a tariff advantage for Indian exporters over competing economies such as Bangladesh, Vietnam and Indonesia in the US market.
India wants to ensure its exporters face tariffs no higher than those imposed on competing economies.
Trade Secretary Rajesh Agrawal echoed Goyal's comments.
"We anticipate concluding and signing the trade deal at the earliest possible time," Agrawal said, adding that India was seeking preferential market access and greater tariff stability under the proposed agreement.
India's goods exports to the United States rose to $42.79 billion in April-August from $40.39 billion a year earlier. In the fiscal year 2025/26, India recorded a trade surplus of nearly $34 billion with the United States.
Neither side has publicly detailed the reasons for the delay, but one recent complication has been a new US law that could pave the way for tariffs of up to 100% on Indian goods because of New Delhi's continued purchases of Russian oil.
The trade talks have unfolded against a backdrop of increasingly strained ties between India and the United States, complicating efforts to steady their trade partnership.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will [USN:L1N45Z14R TEXT:"visit India"] and Uzbekistan, from October 17 to 22, and will meet government and business leaders to discuss energy cooperation, commercial investment and broader economic ties.

items.title: Portuguese airline deal straps in FOMO premium
items.author: Oliver Taslic
items.creator: Oliver Taslic
items.summary: Lisbon chose Lufthansa over Air France-KLM in the battle for state-owned TAP. The implied $5 bln enterprise value looks rich compared with peers. But with few big airlines left to buy, and transatlantic markets booming, fear of missing out helps explain the price tag.
items.body:
Deutsche Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) is putting a high-flying valuation on one of Europe’s last big independent flag carriers. The German group on Wednesday [USN:L6N4600RJ TEXT:"beat"] rival Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) in the race to buy a minority holding in Portugal’s state-owned TAP. The rich proposed price – €1 billion for a 44.9% stake, potentially increasing to €1.2 billion for 49.9% – looks to be driven by a fear of missing out on both healthy transatlantic travel and a dwindling number of viable M&A targets.
The process to privatise TAP, which needed a government [USN:L8N2IQ3ET TEXT:"bailout"] during the pandemic, was [USN:S8N3LC0DD TEXT:"relaunched"] last summer after a previous attempt [USN:S8N3LC0DD TEXT:"stalled"]. The plan foresaw the state retaining a majority holding and a 44.9% stake for a private owner, which could rise to 49.9% depending how many employees take up an offered 5% overall shareholding. British Airways owner IAG (ICAG.L) [USN:FWN40K1CZ TEXT:"dropped out"] in April, after its finance chief bemoaned the lack of a “clear path” to majority ownership. Air France-KLM seemed a [USN:L6N40P0ID TEXT:"logical owner"], given its large government shareholders and lack of a southern European hub to complement Paris and Amsterdam. But Lufthansa carried the day with a bid that Portuguese Prime Minister Luís Montenegro [USN:L6N4600RJ TEXT:"said"] was 16% higher than Air France-KLM’s.
The appeal is clear. With hubs on the western edge of Iberia and strong links into Brazil, TAP enjoyed a 12% share of seats between Europe and South America last year, according to Cirium data. That gives Lufthansa a leg-up into a [USN:L6N3X90TD TEXT:"booming aviation market"] dominated by IAG, Air France-KLM and Chile-listed LATAM (LTM.SN) . TAP is also one of the last big independent flag carriers [USN:L6N44Z0JV TEXT:"left to buy"], while operating margins of 6% in 2025 and 9% in 2024 are respectable. Lufthansa CEO Carsten Spohr also envisages up to €450 million of annual “synergies”, usually meaning cost savings and revenue boosters, which don’t depend on taking full control of TAP.
The issue is the valuation. Bernstein analysts wrote last November that €700 million for the stake would be “comparatively rich”. The winning bid has blown far past that – even though the Iran war has dented the sector’s prospects since then. Using €1.2 billion for a 49.9% stake, the implied equity value for TAP is €2.4 billion. Add the airline’s €2.1 billion of net debt as of June, and the enterprise value Lufthansa is paying works out around €4.5 billion. That’s 6.7 times the last 12 months’ of EBITDA to June. For comparison, the average equivalent multiple for IAG, Lufthansa, Air France-KLM and Finnair (FIA1S.HE) is 3.2, according to Visible Alpha. True, the TAP multiple potentially falls to 4.3 after including the full €450 million of synergies after deducting tax at 17%, based on Breakingviews estimates. But that still looks comparatively pricey.
There are strategic questions, too. Barclays analysts wrote last week that competition between TAP and Italy’s ITA – another South America-heavy airline, which Lufthansa has exercised an option to take a majority stake in – could present a “challenge”. Still, investors don’t seem too begrudging: shares in Lufthansa fell 2% on Wednesday, only slightly more than Air France-KLM or IAG. Greater South Atlantic weighting could help Lufthansa in the end. But it comes through a haze of FOMO.
Follow @Breakingviews on X
CONTEXT NEWS Portugal’s government on October 14 picked Deutsche Lufthansa to buy a stake of up to 49.9% in TAP Air Portugal for €1.2 billion. The German airline group beat its rival Air France-KLM.
Lufthansa said on October 15 that it expects up to €450 million of synergies from the combination.

items.title: Banks need 'bare metal' recovery in face of AI risks, says BoE's Breeden
items.author: Rae Wee, Phoebe Seers
items.creator: Rae Wee, Phoebe Seers
items.summary: Bank of England Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden said on Thursday the central bank was working with banks on deep cyber-recovery options, arguing that lenders can no longer assume their defences are impenetrable in the face of AI-enabled cyber attacks.
items.body:
Bank of England Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden said on Thursday the central bank was working with banks on deep cyber-recovery options, arguing that lenders can no longer assume their defences are impenetrable in the face of AI-enabled cyber attacks.
Breeden also warned that AI advancements had reached a level where the technology posed a "systemic risk" to global financial infrastructure.
"It's not enough now to assume that the cyber attackers won't get through....We need to be thinking about what are the bare metal recovery options...that we need for the core services, and we need to think about that end-to-end across the financial system," she said at the Institute of International Finance annual meeting in Bangkok.
So-called 'bare metal' systems are entirely independent from a bank's main tech set-up and can kick in if primary operating systems are compromised.
Banking regulators globally are stepping up efforts to contain growing AI risks, including in Britain where supervisors have been encouraging the largest banks to examine bare metal recovery plans, Reuters [USN:L6N45Z0FI TEXT:"reported"] on Tuesday.
Breeden also warned that the risks of larger and more complex cyber attacks had grown due to AI developments.
"The basics of cyber hygiene... those are more important than ever," she said. "Cyber is always the thing that I say keeps me up at night. What is the thing that I worry about the most is waking up and one of our most systemically important banks or a bit of core infrastructure has been attacked and is paralysed."

items.title: UK's Healey says banks are key to economy but keeps tax options open
items.author: David Milliken
items.creator: David Milliken
items.summary: British finance minister John Healey said banks were central to the country's economic future on Thursday when pressed by reporters about the likelihood of a windfall tax on their bumper profits in his first budget on October 28.
items.body:
British finance minister John Healey said banks were central to the country's economic future on Thursday when pressed by reporters about the likelihood of a windfall tax on their bumper profits in his first budget on October 28.
Increasing the 3% surcharge for banks on top of standard corporation tax could raise billions of pounds at a time when many lenders have profited from rising interest rates.
However, banks argue they are already highly taxed in Britain compared with some other major financial centres and some analysts say higher bank taxes would see them put up charges.
"My observation on the banks is that people too often see them as big, distant financial institutions, when they are hardwired into the economic fabric of this country and our future prospects," Healey told reporters in Bangkok, where he is attending the International Monetary Fund's annual meeting.
"That said, I've got decisions to take in the budget and I will," he added, noting that his comments were not intended to be a steer on any intended tax changes.
MANY BANKING ANALYSTS HAVE PENCILLED IN TAX RISE Analysts covering British banks have in recent weeks suggested an increase in the surcharge that banks pay on their profits is likely, with both a return to the previous 8% level and a smaller rise of 2-3 percentage points seen as options.
The surcharge currently raises just over £1 billion ($1.3 billion) a year.
However, bank bosses have grown more confident that they will avoid such increases. The chief executives of two British lenders told Reuters in recent weeks they did not expect any increase after arguing that such a tax hike could curb lending.
Trade body UK Finance said in response to Healey's comments that an increase in bank taxes "would weaken the UK's competitiveness, discourage investment and job creation, and work against the government's ambition to deliver growth".
In an interview with Bloomberg Television, Healey described banks as "a part of the jewel ... in the British economic crown".
When asked if higher taxes on banks could be offset by lower capital requirements, he said he would not be drawn into budget speculation.
UK MAY NEED HIGHER TAXES TO KEEP DEFICIT REDUCTION ON TRACK This week, the IMF singled out Britain for praise among major advanced economies for starting a process of deficit reduction that aims at balancing non-investment spending with tax revenue by the 2029/30 tax year.
Previous governments have struggled to meet similar rules, due to economic shocks and setting only medium-term goals.
Healey told reporters on Thursday that he intended to "stay the path" on deficit reduction in his first budget, when higher inflation and a global rise in interest rates are likely to narrow the margin he has for hitting his goals.
"I've said from day one and week one – and I have (Prime Minister) Andy Burnham in lockstep alongside me – I will meet those fiscal rules," he said.
"I want the budget to be a budget that gives a bit of breathing space but also reinforces the strength of our fiscal plans," Healey added.
British government borrowing costs last week hit their highest since 1998 and are greater than in any other major advanced economy.

items.author: CNA
items.summary: BUCHAREST: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday (Oct 15) from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight inside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into Romanian airspace, Romanian officials said.Romanian officials stopped short of expli

Two ships ablaze in Romanian Black Sea waters, 7 sailors missing

A cargo ship is pictured in the Black Sea in Krapets, on Oct 14, 2026, a day after suspected Russian drones struck two cargo ships off Bulgaria, sinking one vessel and leaving 11 sailors missing in the latest spillover from the Ukraine war in the Black Sea. (Photo: AFP/Nikolay Doychinov)

BUCHAREST: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday (Oct 15) from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight inside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into Romanian airspace, Romanian officials said.
Romanian officials stopped short of explicitly linking the fires onboard the ships to the Russian drones. But the incidents follow drone strikes on at least five other cargo ships near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring fellow NATO member Bulgaria over the past 10 days. At least 23 sailors were lost from those strikes, which unlike the latest incidents took place just outside NATO's territorial waters.
The two ships hit overnight were both anchored in the Black Sea near the mouth of the canal leading into the Danube River, a major shipping route used by Ukraine as Russia has attacked Ukraine's own Black Sea ports.
Romania's naval authority said it received an emergency alert from the San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader. Seven of its 12 crew were missing and 5 were rescued.

The interior ministry said it had sent two Black Hawk helicopters to the search and rescue mission, as well as two ships with medical staff on board.
"At the moment, the rescue cannot be done safely because of very big waves," it said in a statement.
Late on Wednesday, the Comoros-flagged chemical and oil tanker Yara J also caught fire. Romanian authorities initially said it was not clear whether it had been attacked. All its crew were safe.
Romania shares a 614km border with Ukraine, much of it along the Danube. It has reported repeated breaches of its airspace by Russian drones over the past four years.
Both Wine Trader and Yara J caught fire near the mouth of the Danube River's Sulina Canal leading to the Black Sea, where ships often anchor waiting to pass because of delays from weather and congestion.
Increasing attacks on Black Sea shipping connected with the Russia-Ukraine war in recent months have threatened to cause a global food crisis, as both countries are major exporters of grain, as is Romania.
"We're looking at the Black Sea as a global food artery," Romanian Foreign Minister Oana Toiu told a security conference in Warsaw earlier this week.
"It is currently, unfortunately, the deadliest sea when it comes to the number of casualties of sailors in the last months. That means we need to increase our investments in deterrence, defence."
Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev said EU leaders would discuss on Thursday a proposed moratorium on attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea.
Russia has been bombing Ukraine's Black Sea ports, forcing Kyiv to rely increasingly on Danube River ports and shipping routes close to the coasts of Bulgaria and Romania. For its part, Ukraine has targeted Russian ships near the mouth of the Don River in the Azov Sea.

items.title: Lufthansa setzt bei TAP auf rasche Synergien und schnelle EU-Genehmigung
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Lufthansa erhofft sich vom Einstieg bei der portugiesischen Airline TAP rasche Impulse und setzt auf eine vergleichsweise schnelle Genehmigung durch die EU-Wettbewerbshüter. "TAP passt perfekt zu uns", sagte Lufthansa-Chef Carsten Spohr am Donnerstag in einem Investoren-Call. Gleich vom ersten Tag an werde Mehrwert geschaffen - für die Lufthansa-Aktionäre und die TAP-Investoren. Insgesamt verspreche man sich mittelfristig Synergien von bis zu 450 Millionen Euro jährlich, sagte Finanzchef Till Streichert. Der volle Umfang dürfte erst einige Jahre nach Abschluss der Übernahme erreicht sein. Der mit der portugiesischen Regierung verhandelte Deal solle bald unterzeichnet werden. Komplett über die Bühne gehe die Transaktion wohl im ersten Halbjahr 2028.
items.body:
Die Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) erhofft sich vom Einstieg bei der portugiesischen Airline TAP rasche Impulse und setzt auf eine vergleichsweise schnelle Genehmigung durch die EU-Wettbewerbshüter. "TAP passt perfekt zu uns", sagte Lufthansa-Chef Carsten Spohr am Donnerstag in einem Investoren-Call. Gleich vom ersten Tag an werde Mehrwert geschaffen - für die Lufthansa-Aktionäre und die TAP-Investoren. Insgesamt verspreche man sich mittelfristig Synergien von bis zu 450 Millionen Euro jährlich, sagte Finanzchef Till Streichert. Der volle Umfang dürfte erst einige Jahre nach Abschluss der Übernahme erreicht sein. Der mit der portugiesischen Regierung verhandelte Deal solle bald unterzeichnet werden. Komplett über die Bühne gehe die Transaktion wohl im ersten Halbjahr 2028.
Spohr geht davon aus, dass die EU-Kommission allerdings schneller entscheiden dürfte als bei der Lufthansa-Übernahme der italienischen Airline ITA, weil es mit der TAP weniger Überlappungen im Flugbetrieb gebe. Spohr signalisierte, dass er nicht so sehr mit Auflagen rechne wie beim Kauf von ITA. Zudem hätten die Politiker in Europa verstanden, dass es wichtig sei, größere Unternehmen zu bilden, um im internationalen Wettbewerb mithalten zu können.
Portugals Regierung hatte der deutschen Airline am Mittwoch den Zuschlag gegeben, sich mit bis zu 49,9 Prozent an der verstaatlichten TAP zu beteiligen. In einem ersten Schritt erhält die Lufthansa 44,9 Prozent - für 1,025 Milliarden Euro. Dieser Anteil könnte auf bis zu 49,9 Prozent steigen - für dann bis zu 1,2 Milliarden Euro. Dies gilt für den Fall, dass die TAP-Belegschaft ihr Bezugsrecht für fünf Prozent am TAP-Kapital nicht ausübt. Im Bieterrennen setzte sich die Lufthansa gegen den Rivalen Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) durch.
PORTUGAL KÖNNTE KÜNFTIG FÜNF PROZENT AN LUFTHANSA HALTEN Portugal will die in der Corona-Krise 2020 verstaatlichte Fluggesellschaft wieder teilprivatisieren und hat den Prozess im Juli 2025 neu gestartet. Künftig soll es auch Gespräche geben über die 50,1 Prozent, die Portugal dann noch an der TAP hält. Wenn die deutsche Airline diesen Anteil wie geplant - etwa im Tausch von Lufthansa-Aktien - auch übernehme, könne der portugiesische Staat mit bis zu fünf Prozent Anteilseigner bei der Lufthansa werden, sagte Streichert.
Aber auch schon als Minderheitsaktionär wird die Lufthansa künftig die operative Führung bei TAP übernehmen und darf den Chefposten bestimmen.
Für die Lufthansa sind vor allem Verbindungen nach Lateinamerika interessant, insbesondere nach Brasilien, wie Spohr betonte. Lissabon soll als Drehkreuz gestärkt werden und die nationale Identität der Airline TAP wie bei anderen Töchtern der Gruppe gewahrt bleiben. TAP gilt auch wegen ihrer Verbindungen in das portugiesischsprachige Afrika und in die USA als attraktiv. Die Lufthansa hat der Regierung in Lissabon versprochen, das Wachstum von TAP voranzutreiben. So soll die Flotte von zuletzt rund 100 Flugzeugen ausgebaut werden - auf 117 Maschinen bis 2035. Und danach auf 130, wenn der neue Airport in Lissabon in Betrieb ist.
Spohr sagte, die TAP sei bereits profitabel und habe vier Jahre in Folge Gewinn eingeflogen - dies sei für Übernahmen der Lufthansa-Gruppe eher ungewöhnlich. Im ersten Halbjahr 2026 beförderte TAP 8,2 Millionen Passagiere und damit so viele wie nie zuvor. Zugleich kletterten die operativen Erlöse auf den Rekordwert von 2,04 Milliarden Euro. Allerdings weitete sich der Nettoverlust im saisonal schwächeren ersten Halbjahr auf 99,2 Millionen Euro aus, was vor allem auf gestiegene Kerosinkosten zurückzuführen war.

items.title: Albania's leader defies calls to resign as student protesters rampage in capital
items.author: Fatos Bytyci, Edward Mcallister
items.creator: Fatos Bytyci, Edward Mcallister
items.summary: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama on Thursday rejected calls to resign as thousands of student-led protesters smashed windows and fought running battles with riot police firing water cannon and tear gas in the capital.
items.body:
Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama on Thursday rejected calls to resign as thousands of student-led protesters smashed windows and fought running battles with riot police firing water cannon and tear gas in the capital.
Protesters voiced anger about perceived corruption, the cost and quality of education and a deal to sell off parts of its pristine southern coastline to a luxury resort development backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner.
They demanded Rama's resignation, saying no one had listened to their concerns during a summer of largely peaceful protests over the development.
In a written statement to Reuters, Rama rejected calls to quit.
"My responsibility is to listen, address legitimate concerns and keep Albania moving forward. The alternative would be a betrayal of the Albanians who gave me a strong mandate to complete negotiations on European Union membership," he said.
RAMA CONDEMNS ATTACKS ON PUBLIC PROPERTY A student who gave her name as Kiara said the cost of living, poor job prospects, and alleged corruption were the main issues.
"Our prime minister is the meaning of the word corruption. You can only find work in your field if you know a guy who knows a guy," she said, her face covered by a mask, like many on the streets on Thursday.
The protests, now [USN:L1N4600LQ TEXT:"in their third day"], mark the biggest challenge yet to Rama, who won a fourth term last year, with EU membership at the centre of his campaign. Parliament cancelled its session as the violence erupted again nearby.
Rama, whose government denies corruption, said he would be ready to discuss the rising cost of education, but added: "Attacking institutions, destroying public property and threatening public safety have nothing to do with the legitimate demands of students."
Tirana's streets were littered with burned out garbage bins, shattered bus stops and broken traffic lights.
Wafts of tear gas drifted across the centre. Protesters hurled stones at police, who used water cannon to push protesters back. In the central Skanderbeg Square, police hit fleeing protesters with batons as tourists looked on.
PROTESTER SAYS THEY ARE NOT BEING HEARD "This government is corrupted, led and governed by a corrupt prime minister," protester Lulzim Tanushi, a lawyer, said. "Since Rama came to power he has abused and ruined people's lives and that is why people are showing their anger — when they were not heard before."
The protests follow months of mostly peaceful demonstrations sparked by the plans to build the resort, which has faced legal challenges.
Villagers told Reuters in July that their land was [USN:L6N4380FB TEXT:"wrongfully sold for development"]. Reuters later reported that the man who sold the land was wanted by prosecutors for drug trafficking, charges his lawyer denied.
Reuters found no evidence of wrongdoing by Kushner, who is not directly involved in the villagers' dispute.
AIMING FOR EU ENTRY AS SOON AS 2028 Albania's image has been tarnished over the years by corruption scandals and political analysts say the country is a hub for gangs seeking to launder money from drugs and weapons trafficking, complicating its efforts to join the EU.
Along with Montenegro, Albania is currently leading the accession process among Balkan countries and is aiming for entry as early as 2028.
"Corruption must be confronted and, as the EU itself has recently reaffirmed, Albania is tackling it as never before," Rama said to Reuters.
"Perhaps some forces, at home and abroad, do not want Albania to succeed as a forerunner for EU membership. But I will not allow violence to derail Albania's European future."
A European Union mission to Albania in a statement on X said: "Constructive dialogue is the only way forward."
The unrest is part of a wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students have staged weeks of protests and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education.

items.title: Apple prepara el lanzamiento de sus primeras funciones de IA en China en diciembre
items.author: Mark Gurman
items.summary: Apple prevé lanzar Apple Intelligence en diciembre, tras años de retrasos regulatorios en China. La primera versión incluirá funciones básicas, pero dejará por fuera la nueva Siri con IA.
items.body: Bloomberg — Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) se está preparando para lanzar su plataforma de inteligencia artificial en China continental, tras un prolongado retraso normativo que ha mantenido las funciones de IA de la empresa fuera de uno de sus mercados más importantes. El fabricante del iPhone tiene previsto lanzar ‘ Apple Intelligence ’ en la región en diciembre, como parte de la próxima actualización a iOS 27.3, según fuentes conocedoras del asunto. El lanzamiento incluirá las funciones de IA que se introdujeron por primera vez en Estados Unidos hace dos años en el iPhone, el iPad y el Mac. Ver más: OpenAI se compromete a no usar secretos comerciales de Apple durante una audiencia clave El lanzamiento excluirá al nuevo asistente de IA Siri y otras funciones anunciadas este año, según indicaron dichas fuentes, que solicitaron permanecer en el anonimato debido a que los planes son confidenciales. La empresa recibió en julio la aprobación preliminar para introducir Apple Intelligence en China, pero recientemente ha mantenido conversaciones adicionales con el Ministerio de Industria y Tecnología de la Información del país para obtener la autorización necesaria para su lanzamiento al mercado. Tim Cook, presidente ejecutivo de Apple, asistió el mes pasado a una cena de Estado en la Casa Blanca en honor del presidente chino Xi Jinping. El lanzamiento en China se producirá tras años de trabajo por parte de Apple. En un momento dado, la empresa creía que el lanzamiento tendría lugar en mayo de 2025. Este se retrasó hasta finales de 2025 y, posteriormente, de nuevo hasta la pasada primavera, mientras el gobierno chino mantenía a la empresa en la incertidumbre respecto al proceso de aprobación. Un portavoz de Apple, con sede en Cupertino (California), se negó a hacer comentarios. Para conseguir la aprobación de Apple Intelligence, la empresa tuvo que hacer algunas concesiones. A diferencia de lo que ocurre en otros países, la plataforma cuenta con medidas de control desarrolladas junto con la empresa china Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. ( BABA ), incluido un filtro que permite al gobierno aprobar las actualizaciones continuas de los modelos de IA. Apple también está colaborando con Baidu Inc. ( BIDU ) en funciones relacionadas con la búsqueda y Siri. Ver más: 10 cosas que saber del iPhone Duo a pocos días de su llegada oficial a las tiendas Apple El 29 de septiembre, Apple recibió los permisos chinos que permiten que los modelos recientes de iPhone sean compatibles con el uso de Apple Intelligence y los modelos de IA de Alibaba, entre los que se incluyen Tongyi Wanxiang y Qwen. La versión inicial de Apple Intelligence incluye funciones como los emojis personalizados Genmoji, resúmenes de notificaciones, herramientas de escritura y la capacidad de eliminar elementos específicos de las fotos. Sin embargo, no está claro si esta tecnología impresionará a los consumidores chinos. Muchas de las funciones iniciales de IA de Apple fueron ampliamente criticadas por no funcionar correctamente y por no estar a la altura de las ofertas de la competencia. Esto llevó a la empresa a renovar Apple Intelligence e introducir Siri AI este año. Sin embargo, ese nuevo asistente, que se ha rediseñado utilizando modelos de Google Gemini, no se lanzará en China como parte de esta implantación. Lo mismo ocurre con otras funciones nuevas de Apple Intelligence, entre las que se incluyen la posibilidad de ampliar una foto, una versión mejorada de las herramientas de escritura, Genmoji considerablemente mejorado y un modo de Siri para la inteligencia visual en la cámara. Los directivos de Apple no se muestran optimistas respecto a que Siri AI se lance en China a corto plazo. La primera versión de Apple Intelligence en China tampoco contará con las herramientas propias de la empresa para la generación de imágenes, incluida la aplicación Image Playground, con el fin de cumplir con la normativa. Algunas funciones para la generación de texto también estarán limitadas en determinadas aplicaciones. Ver más: Apple lanza nuevos productos y supera los US$5 billones, pero Wall Street duda de su crecimiento Dada la proliferación de servicios de IA en los teléfonos de la competencia, como los de Huawei Technologies Co., Xiaomi Corp., Oppo Guangdong Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Vivo Mobile Communication Co. y otros fabricantes en China, no está claro en qué medida se beneficiará Apple del lanzamiento en el país de un conjunto de funciones de IA relativamente básicas que ya tienen dos años de antigüedad. La otra gran región en la que Apple ha tenido dificultades para implementar sus últimas funciones es la Unión Europea. La empresa lanzó allí las funciones iniciales de Apple Intelligence meses después de su debut en EE.UU. en 2024. Con las últimas capacidades, Apple recibió autorización para introducir la mayoría de ellas en Europa según lo previsto en septiembre. Sin embargo, la IA de Siri sigue sin estar disponible en la UE en los iPhone, iPad y Apple Watch. Fuentes conocedoras del asunto afirman que aún no está claro si Apple recibirá la autorización para su lanzamiento local, ni cuándo lo hará. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: POLL BoE to raise rates to 4% in November, but economists narrowly expect hold from there
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Bank of England will raise Bank Rate for the first time in more than three years to 4.0% in November, according to a majority of economists polled by Reuters who have reversed course on the likelihood of a rate rise this year due to persistently high inflation.
items.body:
The Bank of England will raise Bank Rate for the first time in more than three years to 4.0% in November, according to a majority of economists polled by Reuters who have reversed course on the likelihood of a rate rise this year due to persistently high inflation.
But there is still no majority among central bank watchers, who have been more guarded than financial market traders, for a further rate rise beyond next month. Markets are fully pricing in four quarter-point rate rises by the end of next year.
So far, hefty energy price rises stemming from the US-Israeli war with Iran that began in late February have not spilled into broader consumer price rises, although inflation has broadly been above the BoE's 2.0% target for more than five years.
With the British economy consistently [USN:L8N4610AT TEXT:"beating expectations"], government bond yields on the rise, [USN:L8N45806W TEXT:"inflation"] at 3.1% and forecast to rise to roughly double the target and no sign of the war ending any time soon, most say it is now time to increase borrowing costs.
A strong majority – 54 of 63 economists polled between October 12 and 14 – forecast the BoE would raise Bank Rate by 25 basis points next month, which coincides with the central bank's next set of quarterly forecasts.
In last month's survey, about 90% of respondents forecast rates to stay on hold for the remainder of the year.
Sonali Punhani, UK economist at Bank of America, who recently changed her view from hold to a hike, said: "The bigger pickup in inflation is still ahead of us rather than behind us."
"As a central bank, if you are heading towards inflation close to or above 4%, the risk-reward is probably leaning towards the direction of a hike versus a hold and hoping second-round effects don't come in," she said.
GOVERNOR HAS HINTED AT RATE RISE While the BoE was one of the first central banks to raise rates in the last cycle, others, including the [USN:L1N452054 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] and [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"Federal Reserve"], have already begun to lift borrowing costs.
BoE Governor Andrew Bailey, who so far has been reluctant to cast a vote for a rate rise, dropped a clear hint at the [USN:L8N4590W3 TEXT:"last"] Monetary Policy Committee meeting that higher rates were likely on the way.
"The conditions are now moving to a place where that rate hike will need to be delivered, at least according to the guidance that Governor Bailey gave," said Dani Stoilova, UK and Europe economist at BNP Paribas.
Still, there is no majority view among economists beyond the rate rise expected for November. Nearly half of economists polled, 30 of 61, expected one more rise in the first quarter of 2027.
BoE Chief Economist Huw Pill, who has been voting for a rate increase since April, [USN:L1N461041 TEXT:"again pushed back"] on Thursday against market expectations for a series of hikes.
British inflation is forecast to average 3.6% this quarter and 3.8% next, and 3.0% for calendar year 2027. Those forecasts were all revised up from 3.3%, 3.2%, 2.5% in last month's poll.
Higher inflation expectations have driven a surge in government bond yields around the world in recent months, taking British government borrowing costs to their highest in decades ahead of the October 28 budget from finance minister John Healey.
[USN:L1N4610D3 TEXT:"Healey"] should rebuild his depleted headroom against the fiscal rules to about £15-16 billion (£20-21 billion) at this month's budget to keep bond investors onside, according to a majority of economists surveyed.
The British economy put in the best growth performance among Group of Seven developed economies in the first half of the year.
But economists have made only a modest upward revision to this year's growth forecast to 1.3%, up from 1.1%, but held their 2027 and 2028 forecasts at 1.2% and 1.5%.
([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

items.title: 金融調節は日銀に委ねるべき、リフレ政策採る状況ではない＝城内経財相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rocky Swift　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 １５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rocky Swift　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は１５日、金融政策調節は日銀に委ねるべきだとし、中央銀行の独立性を尊重する政府の立場を改めて示した。市場では追加利上げの見通しを見極める動きが続いている。

城内氏はＬＳＥＧが主催した「ロイターネクスト・ニュースメーカー」で、一般論として政府は２％の物価目標の達成に向けた金融政策運営は日銀に委ねられていると理解していると指摘。その上で、金融調節は日銀に「しっかり委ねることが大事だ」と語った。

城内氏は過去に利上げに慎重な姿勢を示したことや、景気刺激策を支持する議員グループとの関係から、市場ではリフレ派と見なされることが多い。しかし、日本はもはやリフレ政策を採用するような状況にはなく、高市政権はそうした政策を決して進めていないと述べた。

日本経済については「成長志向の新たな経済へと移行しつつある」と述べ、長年のデフレで形成された認識ではなく現状に基づき評価するよう世界の投資家に呼びかけた。

「日本経済は、長年のデフレ期とはもはや同じではない。こうした変化する現実に基づいて日本を評価してもらいたい」と指摘。「今こそ日本に投資する時だと考えている」と述べた。

城内氏は、成長のほか財政の持続可能性も重視する姿勢を示し、高市政権下での財政支出拡大を警戒する投資家の懸念払拭を図った。「『積極財政』という言葉を聞いて、単に財政規律の緩和を意味すると受け止める人もいるかもしれないが、われわれが目指しているのはそういうことではない」と述べた。

戦略的投資で日本の潜在成長力が高まれば、財政の持続可能性を維持しながら、賃金や所得、税収の増加につなげられると語った。

items.title: 英企業のコスト削減、インフレ抑制を後押し＝英中銀副総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格高騰への対応として英企業がコスト削減に取り組んでいることで、中銀はインフレを抑えやすくなるとの見方を示した。

ＣＮＢＣテレビのインタビューで「前回エネルギー価格が急騰した２０２２年と大きく異なるのは、人々がコストを価格に転嫁しようとしていない点だ」と指摘した。

「単に価格に転嫁するのではなく、ショックを吸収しようとしている。このため、先行きが不透明な中でも、われわれにとって金融政策の運営がいくらか容易になる」と語った。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行総会に出席するためバンコクを訪れているブリーデン氏は、現在は労働市場が弱いため、ロシアがウクライナへの全面侵攻を始めた２２年のような急激な賃金上昇は起きないことを期待しているとも述べた。

items.title: Cartier-owner Richemont in talks to join bid for diamond giant De Beers, source says
items.author: Clara Denina, Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo
items.creator: Clara Denina, Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo
items.summary: Cartier-owner Richemont is in talks to join a consortium bidding for De Beers, the diamond miner being sold by Anglo American and valued at about $1 billion, a person familiar with the matter said.
items.body:
Cartier-owner Richemont (CFR.S) is in talks to join a consortium bidding for De Beers, the diamond miner being sold by Anglo American (AAL.L) and valued at about $1 billion, a person familiar with the matter said.
A deal would give the Swiss luxury goods group greater influence over a key part of its supply chain as the diamond industry emerges from a prolonged downturn.
Richemont, which also owns jeweller Van Cleef & Arpels, is discussing joining the Global Diamond Consortium, a group led by former De Beers Chief Executive Gareth Penny, the person told Reuters.
Bloomberg News earlier reported the talks, citing people familiar with the matter.
Richemont, worth around $113 billion and cash-rich, was not immediately available for comment. Anglo American declined to comment.
"We view Richemont's potential participation as strategically meaningful but more about optics and long-term natural diamond category positioning than a financial event," RBC analysts said in a note.
Any bid for De Beers, which has been hit by the rise of lab-grown diamonds, would also depend on [USN:L8N43J0T4 TEXT:"Botswana's"] government, which has a first right of refusal, but has yet to say whether it intends to exercise that option.
A spokesperson for Botswana's presidency said on Tuesday the government would not comment until a transaction had been concluded and signed. Officials said this summer a deal was likely to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026.
LONG SEARCH FOR A BUYER Anglo put De Beers [USN:S8N41506W TEXT:"up for sale"] in May 2024 as part of a broader restructuring, after falling diamond prices and growing demand for synthetic stones hit the industry.
[USN:S8N41506W TEXT:"De Beers"] has mining and exploration operations in Botswana, Namibia, Angola, South Africa and Canada.
Its business has suffered in light of the emergence of lab-grown diamonds, which are much cheaper than natural diamonds but have enjoyed global success.
Richemont Chairman and controlling shareholder Johann Rupert, who is South African, has in public comments affirmed his commitment to natural diamonds in high-end jewellery for his brands.
Richemont would not be the first high-end jewellery company to directly invest in the mines that produce its diamonds. British diamond brand Graff, for example, holds a 14.9% stake in Gem Diamonds (GEMD.L) which owns the Letseng mine in Lesotho.
Richemont shares have held up this year and greatly outperformed the struggling luxury sector, supported by the relative strength of jewellery, which consumers see as a store of value. The luxury conglomerate had around €9 billion in net cash at the end of June, according to filings.
The Bloomberg report said negotiations were advanced, though there was no guarantee Richemont would join the consortium.
US jewellery retailer Signet could also join the bid, Bloomberg said. Signet did not immediately reply to a request for comment.

items.title: Cobre cae por tercer día consecutivo ante inflación de EE.UU. y temor a más alzas de tasas
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.summary: La inflación de EE.UU., que superó las expectativas, reforzó las apuestas por nuevas alzas de tasas de la Fed. El cobre cayó un 1,1% y se encamina a su tercera sesión consecutiva de pérdidas.
items.body: Bloomberg — El cobre bajó junto con otros metales básicos después de que los precios al consumo de EE.UU., que superaron las expectativas, impulsaran las apuestas a favor de un endurecimiento más agresivo por parte de la Reserva Federal. Un clima de aversión al riesgo se está extendiendo por los mercados, siendo las acciones tecnológicas las más afectadas, después de que los datos del miércoles mostraran que la inflación en EE.UU. se sitúa en su ritmo más rápido en cinco meses. El cobre en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres bajó un 1,1%, hasta los US$14.329,50 por tonelada, a las 14:53 h, hora de Shanghái, encaminándose hacia su tercera caída diaria consecutiva. Ver más: Supervisores de Escondida aprueban nueva oferta salarial y evitan huelga en la mina de cobre de Chile Los datos de inflación de EE.UU. aumentan las probabilidades de que la Fed aplique más subidas de las tasas de interés en los próximos meses para enfriar la economía, un resultado que podría resultar negativo para los metales, ya que perjudicaría la demanda y elevaría los costos de fabricación. El cobre alcanzó un máximo histórico el mes pasado, pero desde entonces ha fluctuado en medio de la incertidumbre sobre la trayectoria de la Fed. “Los datos del IPC de EE.UU. superaron con creces las previsiones, lo que reforzó las expectativas de inflación y ejerció presión sobre los precios del cobre”, señaló Guangzhou Futures en una nota. Otros metales también registraron caídas en la LME, y el aluminio tocó su mínimo desde el año pasado. El cobre sigue registrando una subida de más del 15% en 2026, después de que un enorme flujo de este metal hacia EE.UU., ante la perspectiva de los aranceles a la importación, dejara a los mercados del resto del mundo con un suministro insuficiente. Sin embargo, el optimismo respecto a la demanda procedente de las infraestructuras de inteligencia artificial también ha impulsado a los alcistas del cobre, lo que ha dejado al metal expuesto a factores adversos en ese sector. Las acciones del sector de la IA se encontraban entre las que más perdieron el jueves, ya que los inversores huyeron del riesgo. El índice bursátil de referencia de Corea del Sur cayó un 8%, ante el nerviosismo de los inversores respecto a la sostenibilidad del gasto en esta tecnología. Ver más: El auge del cobre sacude los mercados: por qué sube, quiénes ganan y qué esperar para 2027 Una caída del cobre al cierre supondría la tercera bajada diaria consecutiva del metal, la racha más larga de este tipo desde junio. Las acciones mineras también se desplomaron, y BHP Group ( BHP ), en Sídney, perdió casi un 5%, lo que supone su mayor caída diaria desde junio. La tendencia bajista del cobre también refleja la disminución de las preocupaciones sobre interrupciones inmediatas del suministro. BHP alcanzó un acuerdo preliminar con los empleados para evitar una huelga en la gigantesca mina de Escondida, en Chile, aunque dicho acuerdo aún está sujeto a la aprobación del sindicato. La producción de cobre de Chile ha tenido dificultades este año. “Esperamos que la fortaleza del dólar y la renovada presión sobre las tasas de interés mantengan al complejo en una posición defensiva, ya que los riesgos de suministro que aún afectan al cobre solo ofrecen un apoyo muy limitado”, escribieron los analistas de Sucden Financial en una nota. El índice del dólar de Bloomberg subió el miércoles hasta su nivel más alto desde mayo de 2025. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Oct 15 : The US Federal Trade Commission has sent civil subpoenas to AI giants Anthropic and OpenAI, seeking documents about safety incidents, Axios reported on Wednesday, citing a person familiar with the matter.
The probe comes amid mounting AI safety concerns after models reportedly hacked websites and behaved deceptively or aggressively in testing, highlighting the risks of increasingly autonomous systems and the adequacy of safeguards against harm.
Last month, Reuters reported that the FTC planned an industry-wide investigation into AI companies.
The FTC also plans to compel executives at top AI developers, including Anthropic, OpenAI and the research group METR to testify.

The FTC, OpenAI and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Axios report.
The regulator's demands run to more than 50 pages each and seek information on security incidents, safeguards, marketing materials and privacy policies, the news website reported.
The FTC has broad authority to sue companies over unfair or deceptive practices, and has used that authority in the past to take action against companies for failing to take reasonable measures to secure consumers' data.
FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson suggested in an interview with Reuters last month that developers who instruct agents in cybersecurity tests that result in hacks should be liable for any harm they cause.

Source: Reuters

[オスロ １５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府が設置した委員会は１５日、世界最大の政府系ファンドであるノルウェー政府年金基金（ＳＷＦ）について、欧米の大手防衛企業への投資を認めるべきだと提言した。これらの企業は核兵器製造に関わっているとして、現在は投資対象から除外されている。

政府と議会が承認すれば、防衛企業への投資額は数百億ドルに上る可能性がある。

現行の規定では、核兵器製造に関与しているとして、欧州エアバス、米ボーイング、ロッキード・マーチン、英ＢＡＥシステムズなどの株式を取得できない。

新規定案では、核拡散防止条約（ＮＰＴ）で核兵器保有国と認められている国（米・英・仏・ロ・中）のうち、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国であるノルウェーと同盟関係にある国に本拠を置く企業は除外対象から外す。

委員会は提言で「これにより、核兵器の部品を製造する欧米企業の一部を投資対象に組み入れることが可能になる」と説明した。

ＮＡＴＯ事務総長を務めたストルテンベルグ財務相は、世界の安全保障情勢の変化やノルウェーがＮＡＴＯの「核の傘」に依存していることを理由に、委員会に倫理規定の見直しを求めていた。

投資対象から除外されている防衛関連企業には、このほか仏サフラン、タレス、米ＢＷＸテクノロジーズ、ノースロップ・グラマン、フルア、ゼネラル・ダイナミクス、ハンティントン・インガルス・インダストリーズ、ジェイコブズ・ソリューションズ、Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズ、印Ｌ＆Ｔがある。

ノルウェー赤十字などの市民団体は、こうした見直しは大量破壊兵器への投資を正当化することになると主張している。赤十字は委員会に提出した意見書で「ノルウェーが巨額の資金をどのように投資するかは、世界の基準づくりに影響する」と述べた。

Oct 15 : Canadian AI lab Cohere said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to buy AISLE, a San Francisco-based cybersecurity startup that uses AI to detect vulnerabilities in software.
The tie-up would add cybersecurity to the business entity Cohere is assembling through its merger with Germany's Aleph Alpha, a combination reported to be worth about $20 billion, and extend its European footprint with AISLE's engineering hub in Prague.
Cohere said the acquisition reflected its continued investment in Europe and would deepen its presence across the region, strengthening European AI.
The deal is aimed at boosting the combined group's security and threat detection capabilities for enterprise and public sector clients, with private deployment available on the customer's own system.

"Increasingly capable AI systems are transforming both cybersecurity and the threats organizations face, and defensive capabilities must advance just as quickly," Cohere said.
AISLE was founded in 2025 by Ondrej Vlcek, former CEO of Czech antivirus maker Avast, with co-founders from Google DeepMind and Anthropic.
AISLE said its AI found more than 500 new bugs in widely used software in its first year, including 12 vulnerabilities in OpenSSL, a free program that encrypts internet traffic for banks, governments and messaging apps, which were fixed after their discovery.
The terms of the deal were not disclosed.

items.title: アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 １５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - １５日の東京市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げに勢いがつき、日経平均は直近高値から６０００円超の下げとなった。ＡＩデータセンター投資に向けた資金調達への懸念がつきまとう中、これまでの期待に基づく買いが巻き戻された形だが、追い証（追加保証金）が多発してセリング・クライマックス（総悲観の投げ売り）をつけるには、なお距離があるとの見方もある。

＜落ちるナイフの局面＞

日経平均はこの日、一時５％超下落し、約１カ月ぶりに６万４０００円近辺まで値を下げた。アドバンテストが約１５％安、ソフトバンクグループが９％安、フジクラが１２％超安とＡＩ関連の主力株が軒並み大きく下げたが、松井証券の窪田朋一郎チーフマーケットアナリストは「まだ落ちてくるナイフを拾っている局面だ」として、大底前の総投げとなるセリング・クライマックスには距離があるとの見方を示す。

株価下落局面の「位置」を把握するうえで注目される指標の一つに信用評価損益率がある。信用取引で買い建てている投資家がどの程度含み損益を抱えているかを表す指標で、マイナス２０％を下回ると追加の担保金差し入れを求められる追い証が発生しやすい。期日までに対応できなければ損失覚悟の処分売りを迫られ、こうした投げが集中するとセリング・クライマックスにつながりやすいとされる。

松井証券店内では１４日時点の評価損益率がマイナス８％。この日の急落を加味してもマイナス１１％程度と松井の窪田氏はみており「日経平均で６万円を割るぐらいでないと、本格的な投げにはなりにくそうだ」と話す。

＜ＡＩ株売りの背景＞

ＡＩ株売りが強まった背景のひとつとして、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービス大手コアウィーブの社債や株価急落への警戒感がある。

同社の５年物ＣＤＳ（クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ）はこのところ、８００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）付近の高水準にあったが、この数日で１１００ｂｐまで拡大した。社債利回りも上がっており、追加の資金調達コストの増加が警戒された。「（データセンターに大規模投資するハイテク大手の）ハイパースケーラーによる資金調達にも波及しかねないとの懸念が強まった」と大和証券の坪井裕豪チーフストラテジストは指摘する。

ハイパースケーラーはこれまで、本業で稼いだ現金を意味する営業キャッシュフロー（ＣＦ）で投資をまかなってきたが、今年に入って営業ＣＦの流入額を投資ＣＦの流出額が上回る企業が出始め、投資継続には資金調達が重要な局面に入ってきている。データセンター投資が鈍るようなら、これまで米ハイテク大手による巨額投資の恩恵が及ぶとみられていた半導体やその製造装置、周辺インフラなどの「ツルハシ銘柄」を巡るシナリオも変わってくる可能性がある。

＜ＩＰＯ先送り＞

企業の資金需要を市場がこなせるか、懸念がくすぶる中、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の動向にも市場の関心は向かっている。

ＡＩ関連では、ＡＩデータセンター関連会社でソフトバンクグループが支援するＳＢエナジーが米国でのＩＰＯロードショー（投資家説明）の開始を先送りしたことが９月に報じられたほか、米ブラックストーンが支援する豪データセンター運営会社エアトランクがシンガポールでのＲＥＩＴ（不動産投資信託）ＩＰＯを２７年に延期したと伝わっている。

市場では、１０─１１月にもと観測されていたＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックのＩＰＯが１１月の米中間選挙後にずれ込む可能性が高いとも伝わっている。評価額２兆ドル規模との試算もある同社のＩＰＯが「延期になったり（評価額が）２兆ドル規模を下回るようだと、売りの口実にされかねない」と松井の窪田氏はみている。

＜焦点は企業業績＞

「米中間選挙のある年の１０月は海外勢が売り越す傾向にあり、きょうの下げにもつながっている可能性がある」と東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの山藤将太エクイティマーケットアナリストは指摘する。一方、「ここから企業業績に目が向かうとすれば、買い戻しが入ってくる余地もありそうだ」という。

大和の坪井氏は、資金調達の難しさが成長途上の企業に限られる話かどうかを見極める必要があるとの見方を示す一方、目先の焦点は、１０月下旬に本格化する米ハイテク企業の決算だと指摘する。「ＡＩビジネスの収益性が確認されれば、不透明感は和らぎ得る」と坪井氏は話している。

ＡＩ株売りが強まった背景のひとつとして、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービス大手コアウィーブの社債や株価急落への警戒感がある。

同社の５年物ＣＤＳ（クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ）はこのところ、８００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）付近の高水準にあったが、この数日で１１００ｂｐまで拡大した。社債利回りも上がっており、追加の資金調達コストの増加が警戒された。「（データセンターに大規模投資するハイテク大手の）ハイパースケーラーによる資金調達にも波及しかねないとの懸念が強まった」と大和証券の坪井裕豪チーフストラテジストは指摘する。

ハイパースケーラーはこれまで、本業で稼いだ現金を意味する営業キャッシュフロー（ＣＦ）で投資をまかなってきたが、今年に入って営業ＣＦの流入額を投資ＣＦの流出額が上回る企業が出始め、投資継続には資金調達が重要な局面に入ってきている。データセンター投資が鈍るようなら、これまで米ハイテク大手による巨額投資の恩恵が及ぶとみられていた半導体やその製造装置、周辺インフラなどの「ツルハシ銘柄」を巡るシナリオも変わってくる可能性がある。

＜ＩＰＯ先送り＞

企業の資金需要を市場がこなせるか、懸念がくすぶる中、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の動向にも市場の関心は向かっている。

ＡＩ関連では、ＡＩデータセンター関連会社でソフトバンクグループが支援するＳＢエナジーが米国でのＩＰＯロードショー（投資家説明）の開始を先送りしたことが９月に報じられたほか、米ブラックストーンが支援する豪データセンター運営会社エアトランクがシンガポールでのＲＥＩＴ（不動産投資信託）ＩＰＯを２７年に延期したと伝わっている。

市場では、１０─１１月にもと観測されていたＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックのＩＰＯが１１月の米中間選挙後にずれ込む可能性が高いとも伝わっている。評価額２兆ドル規模との試算もある同社のＩＰＯが「延期になったり（評価額が）２兆ドル規模を下回るようだと、売りの口実にされかねない」と松井の窪田氏はみている。

＜焦点は企業業績＞

「米中間選挙のある年の１０月は海外勢が売り越す傾向にあり、きょうの下げにもつながっている可能性がある」と東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの山藤将太エクイティマーケットアナリストは指摘する。一方、「ここから企業業績に目が向かうとすれば、買い戻しが入ってくる余地もありそうだ」という。

大和の坪井氏は、資金調達の難しさが成長途上の企業に限られる話かどうかを見極める必要があるとの見方を示す一方、目先の焦点は、１０月下旬に本格化する米ハイテク企業の決算だと指摘する。「ＡＩビジネスの収益性が確認されれば、不透明感は和らぎ得る」と坪井氏は話している。

items.title: India's goods trade deficit widens; focus turns to trade pacts to narrow gap
items.author: Shivangi Acharya, Manoj Kumar
items.creator: Shivangi Acharya, Manoj Kumar
items.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $30.21 billion in September as the rise in imports outpaced that in exports, though a rise in outbound shipments and trade deals could narrow the balance over coming months.
items.body:
India's merchandise trade deficit (INTRD=ECI) widened to $30.21 billion in September as the rise in imports outpaced that in exports, though a rise in outbound shipments and trade deals could narrow the balance over coming months.
The trade gap has widened as Asia's third-largest economy grapples with a prolonged Iran war that has made energy costlier, hurt shipments to the Middle East and battered markets. India raised interest rates earlier this month and announced a raft of measures to support the rupee.
India's trade deficit stood at $26.86 billion in August.
Merchandise exports rose to $44.40 billion in September from $43.81 billion in the previous month, while imports increased to $74.61 billion from $70.67 billion.
Export growth was broad-based, reflecting strength across sectors including petroleum products, meat, dairy, poultry, electronic goods, handicrafts, and engineering goods, Trade Secretary Rajesh Agrawal told reporters.
India is seeking to diversify its export markets, with a trade deal with New Zealand set to take effect next week and its pact with the UK already in force, while a broader agreement with the EU is moving towards implementation.
Agrawal said negotiations with the US were moving in the "right direction," with legal work underway.
"We anticipate concluding and signing the trade deal at the earliest possible time," Agrawal said, adding that India was seeking preferential market access and greater tariff stability under the proposed agreement.
Ties with the US have been rocky this past year over issues including President Donald Trump's repeated claim of brokering an India-Pakistan ceasefire and a US military attack on a ship off Oman that killed three Indian seafarers.
The US remained the top destination for Indian exports, with goods shipments rising to $50.81 billion in April-September from $45.82 billion a year earlier.
India's services exports stood at $36.35 billion in September, and imports at $19.44 billion, trade ministry estimates showed.
Overall goods and services exports rose 13.84% year-on-year to $476.20 billion in April-September from a year earlier, while imports increased 15.68% to $551.13 billion, data showed.
GOLD IMPORTS FALL Gold imports fell to $1.8 billion from $2.3 billion in August, when imports had rebounded sharply on inventory restocking ahead of the festive season. Gold imports for April-September fell 27.32% year-on-year to $19.27 billion.
Export growth in automobiles and resilient services shipments supported India's overall export performance.
India's automobile exports rose 22.5% year-on-year to 684,481 vehicles in September, led primarily by a 26.8% jump in two-wheeler shipments to 544,797 units, data released by an auto manufacturers body showed.
Passenger vehicle exports, however, fell 2.2%.

items.title: Auf EU-Gipfel prallen Positionen im Streit über EU-Finanzrahmen aufeinander
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Auf dem EU-Gipfel in Brüssel sind kontroverse Meinungen zu den künftigen EU-Finanzen aufeinandergeprallt. Die Vorschläge der EU-Kommission und der irischen EU-Ratspräsidentschaft seien für die Mitgliedstaaten finanziell nicht tragbar, sagte Kanzler Friedrich Merz am Donnerstag in Brüssel. Kein Mitgliedsland könne es sich leisten, Beiträge in diesem Umfang zu zahlen. Der schwedische Ministerpräsident Ulf Kristersson kritisierte, die Vorschläge seien nicht einmal ein Startpunkt für Diskussionen. Sie würden dazu führen, dass die schwedische Überweisung nach Brüssel um 60 Prozent steigen würde, was völlig inakzeptabel sei. Dagegen bezeichnete der litauische Präsident Gitanas Nauseda den irischen Vorschlag als "ausgewogen". Französische Regierungsvertreter warnten davor, dass Kürzungen an dem Finanzansatz für 2028 bis 2034 nötige Investitionen in der EU gefährdeten.
items.body:
Auf dem EU-Gipfel in Brüssel sind kontroverse Meinungen zu den künftigen EU-Finanzen aufeinandergeprallt. Die Vorschläge der EU-Kommission und der irischen EU-Ratspräsidentschaft seien für die Mitgliedstaaten finanziell nicht tragbar, sagte Kanzler Friedrich Merz am Donnerstag in Brüssel. Kein Mitgliedsland könne es sich leisten, Beiträge in diesem Umfang zu zahlen. Der schwedische Ministerpräsident Ulf Kristersson kritisierte, die Vorschläge seien nicht einmal ein Startpunkt für Diskussionen. Sie würden dazu führen, dass die schwedische Überweisung nach Brüssel um 60 Prozent steigen würde, was völlig inakzeptabel sei. Dagegen bezeichnete der litauische Präsident Gitanas Nauseda den irischen Vorschlag als "ausgewogen". Französische Regierungsvertreter warnten davor, dass Kürzungen an dem Finanzansatz für 2028 bis 2034 nötige Investitionen in der EU gefährdeten.
Auf dem EU-Gipfel wird nicht mit einer Einigung der 27 EU-Regierungen über den Kompromissvorschlag gerechnet, den die derzeitige irische EU-Ratspräsidentschaft vorgelegt hatte. Strittig ist sowohl die Höhe von mehr als 1,5 Billionen Euro als auch die Frage, in welchen Bereichen die EU-Staaten das Geld ausgeben sollen. Merz verwies auf einen Sondergipfel im November und den EU-Gipfel im Dezember, auf dem die nötige Einstimmigkeit erreicht werden solle. Die Positionen lägen allerdings noch weit auseinander. "Aber wir sollten für die Ratssitzung im Dezember ein paar Oberhemden mehr einpacken als üblicherweise."
Merz hatte sich vor dem Gipfel in Brüssel mit anderen Nettozahler-Staaten wie den Niederlanden, Schweden, Finnland, Dänemark und Österreich getroffen, um eine gemeinsame Position abzusprechen. Auch die 17 sogenannten Kohäsionsländer, die mehr Geld aus Brüssel erhalten, als sie in den EU-Haushalt einzahlen, trafen sich in Brüssel und pochten in einer gemeinsamen Stellungnahme auf deutliche Steigerungen. Sie lehnen zudem nationale Rabatte bei der Berechnung nationaler Zahlungen an Brüssel ab.
In deutschen Regierungskreisen wurde mit Blick auf die von der EU-Kommission und Frankreich gewünschten neuen EU-Steuern betont, dass man jede Festlegung auf Zahlen oder höhere Unternehmenssteuern strikt ablehnen werde. Es sei völlig illusorisch, durch sogenannte EU-Eigenmittel die Ausgabenwünsche zu finanzieren. "Das Ziel des Kanzlers auf diesem Gipfel ist es, dass sich die Dynamik im Denken ändert: Wir müssen sparen." Ansonsten verliere man die Akzeptanz der Öffentlichkeiten in den EU-Staaten in Zeiten, in denen nationale Haushalte unter Druck stünden.
Neben der Debatte über Geld müsse aber verstärkt über Bürokratieabbau gesprochen werden, sagte Merz. Die Bundesregierung kritisiert, dass von den zwölf begonnenen sogenannten Omnibus-Projekten zum Abbau der Regulierung auf EU-Ebene erst zwei verabschiedet worden seien. Deshalb dringe der Kanzler darauf, dass nun auf jedem EU-Gipfel über Themen wie Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und Verteidigung gesprochen werden solle.

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国14カ月ぶり安値、米利上げ観測嫌気
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海 １５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海 １５日 ロイター] - 中国市場は下落し１４カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。予想を上回る米インフレ指標を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まり、ハイテク株を中心に世界的に株安が広がった流れを引き継いだ。

上海総合指数とＣＳＩ３００指数はともに１．６％下落。いずれも２０２５年８月以来の安値で引けた。

上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１．５％安、深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は２．９％下落した。

ＵＢＳ証券の中国株ストラテジスト、レイ・モン氏は「最近の調整は、過熱していたハイテク株の持ち高解消が集中的に進んだことが主因とみられる。投資信託も、元本回復時の解約に関連した圧力に直面している」と指摘。「地政学リスク、米国債利回り、原油価格のボラティリティーがインフレ期待に影響を及ぼし、ドルの流動性が引き締まった結果、市場のリスク選好を圧迫している」と指摘した。

前日の米国市場では、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回る伸びとなり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに動く可能性があるとの観測が一時再燃したことで、ドルが上昇する一方、米株は下落した。

投資家の関心は１９日に発表される中国の第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計に向かっている。貿易から融資まで一連の指標が好調だった中、景気回復の勢いを見極める材料となる。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１５日、アジアの経済成長が２０２７年に減速するとの見通しを示した。イラン戦争に伴うエネルギーショックや人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの調整の可能性、世界的な債券利回り上昇の波及によるリスクが高まっていると警告した。

香港市場ではハンセン指数が１％下落し、ハンセンテック指数は２．７％安となった。アリババの香港上場株は３．７％下落。

items.title: 中国の長期金利が15カ月ぶり低水準、流動性潤沢　緩和観測も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［上海　１５日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［上海　１５日　ロイター］ - 中国の長期金利が１５日、１５カ月ぶりの水準に低下した。中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が流動性を潤沢な状態に保っていることが背景。トレーダーは、金融政策の手がかりを得ようと、来週開催される金融関連会合に注目している。

・中国銀行間市場は今週、資金が潤沢な状態。翌日物レポ金利の平均は１．２５％前後と約５カ月ぶりの低水準。これは、伝えられている人民銀の翌日物リバースレポオペの金利とほぼ同じ水準。

・潤沢な流動性が長期金利を押し下げた。１０年物国債利回りは１．６４％と２０２５年７月以来の低水準に、３０年物利回りは２．０５％に低下した。

・１３日以降、期日を迎えるリバースレポはなかったが、人民銀は７日物オペで資金供給を続けた。また３カ月物と６カ月物の買い切り型リバースレポで、１０月に入ってから差し引き４０００億元（５９７億７０００万ドル）を供給している。

・興業証券のアナリストによると、市場は来週の「金融街フォーラム」を前に金融緩和を織り込み始めた。具体的な措置については、預金準備率や金利の引き下げのほか、人民銀が政策金利の基準を翌日物リバースレポ金利に移し、事実上の利下げに踏み切るとの見方がでている。

・現在、主要な政策金利は７日物リバースレポ金利で、水準は１．４％。

・金融街フォーラムは１９─２２日に北京で開かれ、規制当局が改革政策を打ち出す予定。人民銀の潘功勝総裁は、これまでのフォーラムで政策の枠組みの変更を発表してきた。２５年のフォーラムでは、公開市場での国債売買の再開を表明した。

［上海　１５日　ロイター］ - 中国の長期金利が１５日、１５カ月ぶりの水準に低下した。中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が流動性を潤沢な状態に保っていることが背景。トレーダーは、金融政策の手がかりを得ようと、来週開催される金融関連会合に注目している。

・中国銀行間市場は今週、資金が潤沢な状態。翌日物レポ金利の平均は１．２５％前後と約５カ月ぶりの低水準。これは、伝えられている人民銀の翌日物リバースレポオペの金利とほぼ同じ水準。

・潤沢な流動性が長期金利を押し下げた。１０年物国債利回りは１．６４％と２０２５年７月以来の低水準に、３０年物利回りは２．０５％に低下した。

・１３日以降、期日を迎えるリバースレポはなかったが、人民銀は７日物オペで資金供給を続けた。また３カ月物と６カ月物の買い切り型リバースレポで、１０月に入ってから差し引き４０００億元（５９７億７０００万ドル）を供給している。

・興業証券のアナリストによると、市場は来週の「金融街フォーラム」を前に金融緩和を織り込み始めた。具体的な措置については、預金準備率や金利の引き下げのほか、人民銀が政策金利の基準を翌日物リバースレポ金利に移し、事実上の利下げに踏み切るとの見方がでている。

・現在、主要な政策金利は７日物リバースレポ金利で、水準は１．４％。

・金融街フォーラムは１９─２２日に北京で開かれ、規制当局が改革政策を打ち出す予定。人民銀の潘功勝総裁は、これまでのフォーラムで政策の枠組みの変更を発表してきた。２５年のフォーラムでは、公開市場での国債売買の再開を表明した。

items.title: Russia builds major new drone attack base in six weeks, satellite images show
items.author: Tom Balmforth, Edward Carron
items.creator: Tom Balmforth, Edward Carron
items.summary: The site in what was an empty field in Russia's southwestern Rostov region on August 31 has become a complex facility the size of around 126 soccer pitches, satellite imagery shows.
items.body:
The construction of a large drone launch site near Millerovo, Rostov Region, Russia. PLANET LABS/Pleiades Neo © Airbus DS 2026/Handout via REUTERS Russia has nearly finished building a major new base for launching jet-powered drones in just six weeks, according to defence experts and a Reuters analysis of satellite imagery, in the latest expansion of its attack capability close to Ukraine .
The site in what was an empty field in Russia's southwestern Rostov region on August 31 had become a complex facility the size of around 126 soccer pitches by Wednesday, commercial imagery provided by Planet Labs and Airbus showed.
The construction coincides with a surge in the use of Russian jet-powered attack drones against Ukraine, which is struggling to intercept the faster weapons that can travel at speeds of up to 600 km per hour.
With the full-scale war well into its fifth year, Kyiv expects Russia to further escalate jet drone and missile attacks this winter.
Mike Monnik, founder and CEO of private intelligence company DroneSec, said the site in the imagery would be capable of launching the Geran-4 and Geran-5 models, Russia's newest types of jet-powered drone.
He said the western edge of the facility showed eight platforms for launch rails capable of firing those drones, adding to an existing Russian network of at least 11 fixed launch sites used for drone attacks on Ukraine.
"The speed of construction ... demonstrates the ease with which Russia can bring now-established offensive capabilities to bear rapidly," Monnik said.
Ihor Malchevsky, 69, escapes from a building what went up in flames after it was hit by a Russian jet-powered drone strike in Kyiv, Ukraine, September 28, 2026. REUTERS/Thomas Peter Smoke rises in the aftermath of a Russian jet-powered drone strike, September 28, 2026. REUTERS/Valentyn Ogirenko A Russian jet powered drone strikes on one of Kyiv's bridges, Ukraine October 2, 2026. REUTERS/Valentyn Ogirenko The site, he added, looked very close to completion and it will be "probably a matter of weeks before (it is) fully operational, if not earlier."
A CHALLENGE FOR NATO
The construction of the facility coincides with worsening relations between Russia and the NATO military alliance.
European governments accuse Moscow of stepping up a campaign of sabotage, drone incursions and cyberattacks against them, while Russia warned last month it could use nuclear weapons if NATO attempted to cut off its Kaliningrad exclave.
Monnik said the combination of industrial production of jet-powered drones, their increasing sophistication and the relative lack of comprehensive counter-drone defences in many NATO countries were a challenge for the West.
"This ability to rapidly field an ability to launch large-scale attacks using UAS (unmanned aerial systems) poses a strategic vulnerability for NATO countries," he said.
Monnik said the facility may have the potential to fire 100 jet-powered drones or more in 24 hours, although Russia normally fires them in small numbers throughout the day. It would also depend on factors like available supplies and objectives.
Rob Jordan, programme director at the London-based RUSI think-tank, said the concrete pads and two possible takeoff rails shown in the imagery looked consistent with launch tracks for Russian Geran drones.
"This level of construction in this short a time is impressive," he said. "This shows the relative faith Russia is putting in its deep strike capability – possibly to the detriment of its conventional land forces."
Russia's defence ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the facility and on its jet-powered drone programme more broadly.
USE OF JET DRONES SURGES
Military analysts say Russia has shifted its drone production capabilities to jet-powered models as Ukraine has struggled to counter them.
Russia increased its use of jet-powered drones roughly six-fold over three months this summer, according to Ukrainian military data reported by Reuters last month. Kyiv and the surrounding region were targeted most heavily, the data showed.
The jet drones pose a problem because they are too fast for the interceptor drones designed by Ukraine to cheaply intercept their slower, piston-powered predecessors. Kyiv is now scrambling to devise a solution.
Overhead imagery of the new facility taken on August 31 pictured a few vehicles in a field but no sign of construction. Imagery taken the following morning showed that work had begun.
Satellite imagery shows launch rails being erected at an area where a large drone launch site is under construction, near Millerovo, Rostov Region, Russia, October 11, 2026. 2026 PLANET LABS PBC/Handout via REUTERS Satellite imagery shows launch rails being erected at an area where a large drone launch site is under construction, near Millerovo, Rostov Region, Russia, October 14, 2026. Pleiades Neo © Airbus DS 2026/Handout via REUTERS
Satellite imagery shows a closeup of ongoing work at a site where a large drone launch site is under construction, near Millerovo, Rostov Region, Russia, October 11, 2026. 2026 PLANET LABS PBC/Handout via REUTERS Satellite imagery shows a closeup of ongoing work at a site where a large drone launch site is under construction, near Millerovo, Rostov Region, Russia, October 14, 2026. Pleiades Neo © Airbus DS 2026/Handout via REUTERS The site, which occupies an area of around 0.9 square kilometres, lies about 3.5 km from Russia's Millerovo air base, home to the 31st Guards Fighter Aviation Regiment.
According to DroneSec, the new launch site likely sits within the air defence "bubble" provided by systems at the airbase, making Ukrainian attempts to target the new facility more difficult.
Of the eight launch platforms, two already had rails on them, a Reuters analysis showed. Rails were being constructed on two other pads as well, while other construction work was visible from space over the course of three days this week.

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 15 : An adviser to Europe's highest court recommended on Thursday that TikTok lose its challenge to its "gatekeeper" status under landmark EU rules, backing regulators in a closely watched test of the bloc's efforts to curb Big Tech's power.
The case, the first involving the EU's Digital Markets Act (DMA) to reach the Court of Justice of the European Union, is being closely watched by technology companies seeking clues on whether Europe's courts will reinforce or limit regulators' efforts to boost competition and expand consumer choice.
ByteDance's TikTok is challenging its designation as a gatekeeper under the DMA, a status that subjects companies to a strict set of obligations aimed at preventing anti-competitive practices.
A lower tribunal rejected TikTok's challenge in 2024. Other companies designated as gatekeepers include Alphabet's Google, Meta Platforms, Apple, Amazon, Microsoft and Booking.com.

"The Court should dismiss the action brought by ByteDance (TikTok) against the decision of the Commission designating it as a gatekeeper under the Digital Markets Act," Advocate General Andrea Biondi said in his opinion.
He endorsed the lower court's ruling.
"The General Court did not make the errors of law alleged by ByteDance in rejecting those arguments. In particular, the fact that users also use other social networks does not, in itself, show that TikTok is not an important gateway," Biondi said.
The judges, who are expected to rule in the coming months, follow such non-binding opinions in around four out of five cases.
TikTok did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment.
The DMA imposes a range of obligations on designated gatekeepers, with breaches potentially attracting fines of up to 10 per cent of a company's annual global turnover.
Meta is also challenging the designation of gatekeeper for its Messenger and Marketplace services.
The case is C-627/24 P Bytedance v Commission.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [マドリード １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[マドリード １４日 ロイター] - スペインの国営世論調査機関ＣＩＳが１４日に公表した１０月の調査によると、現時点で選挙が実施された場合、与党・社会労働党（ＰＳＯＥ）の予想得票率が３４％となり、野党・国民党（ＰＰ）の２２．２％を大きく上回る見通し。

・サンチェス首相は、自身が率いる少数与党政権の住宅対策が議会で否決されたことを受け、総選挙を１１月に前倒し実施すると決めた。

・調査は１０月第１週、住宅危機を巡る抗議活動が全国で続く中、５０２５人を対象に実施された。立ち退きを強いられたことが抗議活動のきっかけとなった住宅問題の活動家マリカルメン・アバスカル氏が７日に病院で死去する前に行われた。

・予想得票率の３位は極右政党のボックスで１７．１％。ＰＳＯＥの連立相手で急進左派のスマールは６．１％と後れを取った。スマールは総選挙に向け、他の左派政党との共闘を引き続き協議している。

・一方、他の大半の世論調査では、保守派のＰＰと極右ボックスが合わせて議会の過半数を確保するとの見通しとなっている。

・ＣＩＳの調査では、首相に望ましい人物としてサンチェス氏の支持率が引き続き最高の３９．３％と、ＰＰのアルベルト・ヌニェス・フェイホー党首の１４．７％を２４．６％ポイント上回った。ボックスのサンティアゴ・アバスカル党首は１３．８％だった。

・有権者の懸念事項では住宅問題が首位に急浮上し、スペインの最大の問題として挙げた割合は過去最高の５５．７％と、前月を２０ポイント上回った。次いで移民問題の２０．９％、経済情勢の２０．３％となった。

items.summary: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight just outside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into national airspace, Romanian officials said.
items.body:
Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight just outside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into national airspace, Romanian officials said.
Romanian President Nicusor Dan said the two ships had been struck by drones, but declined to say whether they were Russian.
"Two air drones hit them," Dan told reporters in Brussels ahead of a summit of EU leaders, adding only a few hours had elapsed since the strikes and Romania was waiting for more information.
"There will be a reaction from the Romanian state," he added.
The two ships hit overnight were both anchored in the Black Sea near the mouth of the Sulina canal leading into the Danube River, a major shipping route used by Ukraine as Russia has attacked Ukraine's own Black Sea ports. One was in Romanian waters, the other just outside.
The incidents follow drone strikes on at least five other cargo ships near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring fellow NATO member Bulgaria over the past 10 days. At least 23 sailors were lost from those strikes, which took place just outside NATO's territorial waters.
SEARCH FOR MISSING SAILORS Romania's naval authority said it received an emergency alert from the San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader. Seven of its 12 crew were missing and 5 were rescued. The ship was hit 13 nautical miles southeast of the Sulina canal, one mile outside Romanian waters.
The interior ministry said it had sent two Black Hawk helicopters to the search and rescue mission, as well as two ships with medical staff on board.
"At the moment, the rescue cannot be done safely because of very big waves," it said in a statement.
Late on Wednesday, the Comoros-flagged chemical and oil tanker [USN:L1N46014H TEXT:"Yara J"] also caught fire, 8-10 miles southeast of Sulina, inside national waters. Romanian authorities initially said it was not clear whether it had been attacked. All its crew were safe.
INCREASING ATTACKS ON BLACK SEA SHIPPING Romania shares a 614-km (381-mile) border with Ukraine, much of it along the Danube. It has reported repeated [USN:L1N46014H TEXT:"breaches"] of its airspace by Russian drones over the past four years.
Both Wine Trader and Yara J caught fire near the mouth of the Danube River's Sulina Canal leading to the Black Sea, where ships often anchor waiting to pass because of delays from weather and congestion. Both ships were empty of cargo.
Increasing attacks on Black Sea shipping connected with the Russia-Ukraine war in recent months have threatened to cause a global food crisis, as both countries are major exporters of grain, as is Romania.
"We're looking at the Black Sea as a global food artery," Romanian Foreign Minister Oana Toiu told a security conference in Warsaw earlier this week.
"It is currently, unfortunately, the deadliest sea when it comes to the number of casualties of sailors in the last months. That means we need to increase our investments in deterrence, defence."
Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev said EU leaders would discuss on Thursday a proposed [USN:L8N4610KR TEXT:"moratorium"] on attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea. Dan and Radev will meet NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte later on Thursday.
Russia has been bombing Ukraine's Black Sea ports, forcing Kyiv to rely increasingly on Danube River ports and shipping routes close to the coasts of Bulgaria and Romania. For its part, Ukraine has targeted Russian ships near the mouth of the Don River in the Azov Sea.
